Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage.

Actions.Name: Infernal Sting
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. 15 (2d10 + 4) Piercing damage plus 18 (4d8) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the devil's next turn. While Poisoned, the target can't regain Hit Points.

entities.name: Brass Dragon Wyrmling
entities.description:
*Medium Dragon, Chaotic Good*
AC 15 (natural armor), HP 22 (4d8 + 4)

Actions.Name: Rend
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 7 (1d10 + 2) Slashing damage.

Actions.Name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.Description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 20-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line. Failure: 14 (4d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

Actions.Name: Sleep Breath
Actions.Description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: The target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn, at which point it repeats the save. Second Failure The target has the Unconscious condition for 1 minute. This effect ends for the target if it takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to wake it.

entities.name: Bronze Dragon Wyrmling
entities.description:
*Medium Dragon, Lawful Good*
AC 15 (natural armor), HP 39 (6d8 + 12)

Traits.Name: Amphibious
Traits.Description: The dragon can breathe air and water.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The dragon makes two Rend attacks.

Actions.Name: Rend
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 8 (1d10 + 3) Slashing damage.

Actions.Name: Lightning Breath (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.Description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature in a 40-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line. Failure: 16 (3d10) Lightning damage. Success: Half damage.

Actions.Name: Repulsion Breath
Actions.Description: Strength Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: The target is pushed up to 30 feet straight away from the dragon and has the Prone condition.

entities.name: Brown Bear
entities.description:
*Large Beast, Unaligned*
AC 11 (natural armor), HP 22 (3d10 + 6)

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The bear makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

Actions.Name: Bite
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage.

Actions.Name: Claw
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 5 (1d4 + 3) Slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

entities.name: Bugbear Stalker
entities.description:
*Medium Fey, Chaotic Evil*
AC 15 (natural armor), HP 65 (10d8 + 20)

Traits.Name: Abduct
Traits.Description: The bugbear needn't spend extra movement to move a creature it is grappling.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The bugbear makes two Javelin or Morningstar attacks.

Actions.Name: Javelin
Actions.Description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 10 ft. or range 30/120 ft. 13 (3d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

Actions.Name: Morningstar
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +5 (with Advantage if the target is Grappled by the bugbear), reach 10 ft. 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage.

Bonus Actions.Name: Quick Grapple
Bonus Actions.Description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 13, one Medium or smaller creature the bugbear can see within 10 feet. Failure: The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13).

Attacks.Name: Javelin
Attacks.Reach: Melee or Ranged, reach 10 ft. or range 30/120 ft.

entities.name: Bugbear Warrior
entities.description:
*Medium Fey, Chaotic Evil*
AC 14 (natural armor), HP 33 (6d8 + 6)

Traits.Name: Abduct
Traits.Description: The bugbear needn't spend extra movement to move a creature it is grappling.

Actions.Name: Grab
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 10 ft. 9 (2d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 12).

Actions.Name: Light Hammer
Actions.Description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +4 (with Advantage if the target is Grappled by the bugbear), reach 10 ft. or range 20/60 ft. 9 (3d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.

entities.name: Bulette
entities.description:
*Large Monstrosity, Unaligned*
AC 17 (natural armor), HP 94 (9d10 + 45)

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The bulette makes two Bite attacks.

Actions.Name: Bite
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. 17 (2d12 + 4) Piercing damage.

Actions.Name: Deadly Leap
Actions.Description: The bulette spends 5 feet of movement to jump to a space within 15 feet that contains one or more Large or smaller creatures. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in the bulette's destination space. Failure: 19 (3d12) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage, and the target is pushed 5 feet straight away from the bulette.

Bonus Actions.Name: Leap
Bonus Actions.Description: The bulette jumps up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.

entities.name: Camel
entities.description:
*Large Beast, Unaligned*
AC 10 (natural armor), HP 17 (2d10 + 6)

Actions.Name: Bite
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 4 (1d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.

entities.name: Cat
entities.description:
*Small Beast, Unaligned*
AC 12 (natural armor), HP 2 (1d4)

Traits.Name: Jumper
Traits.Description: The cat's jump distance is determined using its Dexterity rather than its Strength.

Actions.Name: Scratch
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 1 Slashing damage.

entities.name: Centaur Trooper
entities.description:
*Large Fey, Neutral Good*
AC 16 (natural armor), HP 45 (6d10 + 12)

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The centaur makes two attacks, using Pike or Longbow in any combination.

Actions.Name: Pike
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. 9 (1d10 + 4) Piercing damage.

Actions.Name: Longbow
Actions.Description: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 150/600 ft. 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage.

Bonus Actions.Name: Trampling Charge (Recharge 5-6)
Bonus Actions.Description: The centaur moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks and can move through the spaces of Medium or smaller creatures. Each creature whose space the centaur enters is targeted once by the following effect. Strength Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: 7 (1d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition.

entities.name: Chain Devil
entities.description:
*Medium Fiend, Lawful Evil*
AC 15 (natural armor), HP 85 (10d8 + 40)

Traits.Name: Diabolical Restoration
Traits.Description: If the devil dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.

Traits.Name: Magic Resistance
Traits.Description: The devil has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The devil makes two Chain attacks and uses Conjure Infernal Chain.

Actions.Name: Chain
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of two chains, and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

Actions.Name: Conjure Infernal Chain
Actions.Description: The devil conjures a fiery chain to bind a creature. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15, one creature the devil can see within 60 feet. Failure: 9 (2d4 + 4) Fire damage, and the target has the Restrained condition until the end of the devil's next turn, at which point the chain disappears. If the target is Large or smaller, the devil moves the target up to 30 feet straight toward itself. Success: The chain disappears.

Reactions.Name: Unnerving Gaze
Reactions.Description: _Trigger:_ A creature the devil can see starts its turn within 30 feet of the devil and can see the devil. _Response––Wisdom Saving Throw:_ DC 15, the triggering creature. _Failure:_ The target has the Frightened condition until the end of its turn. _Success:_ The target is immune to this devil’s Unnerving Gaze for 24 hours.

entities.name: Chimera
entities.description:
*Large Monstrosity, Chaotic Evil*
AC 14 (natural armor), HP 114 (12d10 + 48)

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The chimera makes one Ram attack, one Bite attack, and one Claw attack. It can replace the Claw attack with a use of Fire Breath if available.

Actions.Name: Bite
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage, or 18 (4d6 + 4) Piercing damage if the chimera had Advantage on the attack roll.

Actions.Name: Claw
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. 7 (1d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

Actions.Name: Ram
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. 10 (1d12 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

Actions.Name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.Description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 31 (7d8) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

entities.name: Chuul
entities.description:
*Large Aberration, Chaotic Evil*
AC 16 (natural armor), HP 76 (9d10 + 27)

Basics.Languages: Understands Deep Speech but can't speak

Traits.Name: Amphibious
Traits.Description: The chuul can breathe air and water.

Traits.Name: Sense Magic
Traits.Description: The chuul senses magic within 120 feet of itself. This trait otherwise works like the Detect Magic spell but isn't itself magical.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The chuul makes two Pincer attacks and uses Paralyzing Tentacles.

Actions.Name: Pincer
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. 9 (1d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of two pincers.

Actions.Name: Paralyzing Tentacles
Actions.Description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, one creature Grappled by the chuul. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. While Poisoned, the target has the Paralyzed condition.

entities.name: Clay Golem
entities.description:
*Large Construct, Unaligned*
AC 14 (natural armor), HP 123 (13d10 + 52)

Basics.Immunities: Acid, Poison, Psychic; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned

Traits.Name: Acid Absorption
Traits.Description: Whenever the golem is subjected to Acid damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Acid damage dealt.

Traits.Name: Berserk
Traits.Description: Whenever the golem starts its turn Bloodied, roll 1d6. On a 6, the golem goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the golem attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the golem attacks an object. Once the golem goes berserk, it continues to be berserk until it is destroyed or it is no longer Bloodied.

Traits.Name: Immutable Form
Traits.Description: The golem can't shape-shift.

Traits.Name: Magic Resistance
Traits.Description: The golem has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The golem makes two Slam attacks, or it makes three Slam attacks if it used Hasten this turn.

Actions.Name: Slam
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. 10 (1d10 + 5) Bludgeoning damage plus 6 (1d12) Acid damage, and the target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Acid damage taken.

Bonus Actions.Name: Hasten (Recharge 5-6)
Bonus Actions.Description: The golem takes the Dash and Disengage actions.

entities.name: Cloaker
entities.description:
*Large Aberration, Chaotic Neutral*
AC 14 (natural armor), HP 91 (14d10 + 14)

Traits.Name: Light Sensitivity
Traits.Description: While in Bright Light, the cloaker has Disadvantage on attack rolls.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The cloaker makes one Attach attack and two Tail attacks.

Actions.Name: Attach
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 13 (3d6 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the cloaker attaches to it. While the cloaker is attached, the target has the Blinded condition, and the cloaker can't make Attach attacks against other targets. In addition, the cloaker halves the damage it takes (round down), and the target takes the same amount of damage. The cloaker can detach itself by spending 5 feet of movement. The target or a creature within 5 feet of it can take an action to try to detach the cloaker, doing so by succeeding on a DC 14 Strength (Athletics) check.

Actions.Name: Tail
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. 8 (1d10 + 3) Slashing damage.

Bonus Actions.Name: Moan
Bonus Actions.Description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 60-foot Emanation originating from the cloaker. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition until the end of the cloaker's next turn. Success: The target is immune to this cloaker's Moan for the next 24 hours.

Bonus Actions.Name: Phantasms (Recharge after a Short or Long Rest)
Bonus Actions.Description: The cloaker casts the Mirror Image spell, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability. The spell ends early if the cloaker starts or ends its turn in Bright Light.

entities.name: Cloud Giant
entities.description:
*Huge Giant, Neutral*
AC 14 (natural armor), HP 200 (16d12 + 96)

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The giant makes two attacks, using Thunderous Mace or Thundercloud in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast Fog Cloud.

Actions.Name: Thunderous Mace
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 10 ft. 21 (3d8 + 8) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Thunder damage.

Actions.Name: Thundercloud
Actions.Description: Ranged Attack Roll: +12, range 240 ft. 18 (3d6 + 8) Thunder damage, and the target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn.

Actions.Name: Spellcasting
Actions.Description:
The giant casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

- At Will: Detect Magic, Fog Cloud, Light
- 1/Day Each: Control Weather, Gaseous Form, Telekinesis

Bonus Actions.Name: Misty Step
Bonus Actions.Description: The giant casts the Misty Step spell, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

entities.name: Cockatrice
entities.description:
*Small Monstrosity, Unaligned*
AC 11 (natural armor), HP 22 (5d6 + 5)

Actions.Name: Petrifying Bite
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. 3 (1d4 + 1) Piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 11. First Failure The target has the Restrained condition. The target repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on itself on a success. Second Failure The target has the Petrified condition, instead of the Restrained condition, for 24 hours.

entities.name: Commoner
entities.description:
*Small Humanoid, Neutral*
AC 10 (natural armor), HP 4 (1d8)

Traits.Name: Training
Traits.Description: The commoner has proficiency in one skill of the DM's choice and has Advantage whenever it makes an ability check using that skill.

Actions.Name: Club
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. 2 (1d4) Bludgeoning damage.

entities.name: Constrictor Snake
entities.description:
*Large Beast, Unaligned*
AC 13 (natural armor), HP 13 (2d10 + 2)

Actions.Name: Bite
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage.

Actions.Name: Constrict
Actions.Description: Strength Saving Throw: DC 12, one Medium or smaller creature the snake can see within 5 feet. Failure: 7 (3d4) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 12).

entities.name: Copper Dragon Wyrmling
entities.description:
*Medium Dragon, Chaotic Good*
AC 16 (natural armor), HP 22 (4d8 + 4)

Actions.Name: Rend
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 7 (1d10 + 2) Slashing damage.

Actions.Name: Acid Breath (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.Description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 20-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line. Failure: 18 (4d8) Acid damage. Success: Half damage.

Actions.Name: Slowing Breath
Actions.Description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: The target can't take Reactions; its Speed is halved; and it can take either an action or a Bonus Action on its turn, not both. This effect lasts until the end of its next turn.

entities.name: Couatl
entities.description:
*Medium Celestial, Lawful Good*
AC 19 (natural armor), HP 60 (8d8 + 24)

Traits.Name: Shielded Mind
Traits.Description: The couatl's thoughts can't be read by any means, and other creatures can communicate with it telepathically only if it allows them.

Actions.Name: Bite
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. 11 (1d12 + 5) Piercing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of the couatl's next turn.

Actions.Name: Constrict
Actions.Description: Strength Saving Throw: DC 15, one Medium or smaller creature the couatl can see within 5 feet. Failure: 8 (1d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

Actions.Name: Spellcasting
Actions.Description:
The couatl casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

- At Will: Detect Evil and Good, Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Shapechange
- 1/Day Each: Create Food and Water, Dream, Greater Restoration, Scrying, Sleep

Bonus Actions.Name: Divine Aid (2/Day)
Bonus Actions.Description: The couatl casts Bless, Lesser Restoration, or Sanctuary, requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

entities.name: Crab
entities.description:
*Small Beast, Unaligned*
AC 11 (natural armor), HP 3 (1d4 + 1)

Traits.Name: Amphibious
Traits.Description: The crab can breathe air and water.

Actions.Name: Claw
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. 1 Bludgeoning damage.

entities.name: Crocodile
entities.description:
*Large Beast, Unaligned*
AC 12 (natural armor), HP 13 (2d10 + 2)

Traits.Name: Hold Breath
Traits.Description: The crocodile can hold its breath for 1 hour.

Actions.Name: Bite
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 12). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition.

entities.name: Cultist
entities.description:
*Small Humanoid, Neutral*
AC 12 (natural armor), HP 9 (2d8)

Actions.Name: Ritual Sickle
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. 3 (1d4 + 1) Slashing damage plus 1 Necrotic damage.

entities.name: Cultist Fanatic
entities.description:
*Small Humanoid, Neutral*
AC 13 (natural armor), HP 44 (8d8 + 8)

Actions.Name: Pact Blade
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 6 (1d8 + 2) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.

Actions.Name: Spellcasting
Actions.Description:
The cultist casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks):

- At Will: Light, Thaumaturgy
- 1/Day Each: Hold Person
- 2/Day Each: Command

Bonus Actions.Name: Spiritual Weapon (2/Day)
Bonus Actions.Description: The cultist casts the Spiritual Weapon spell, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

entities.name: Darkmantle
entities.description:
*Small Aberration, Unaligned*
AC 11 (natural armor), HP 22 (5d6 + 5)

Actions.Name: Crush
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 6 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage, and the darkmantle attaches to the target. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature and the darkmantle had Advantage on the attack roll, it covers the target, which has the Blinded condition and is suffocating while the darkmantle is attached in this way. While attached to a target, the darkmantle can attack only the target but has Advantage on its attack rolls. Its Speed becomes 0, it can't benefit from any bonus to its Speed, and it moves with the target. A creature can take an action to try to detach the darkmantle from itself, doing so with a successful DC 13 Strength (Athletics) check. On its turn, the darkmantle can detach itself by using 5 feet of movement.

Actions.Name: Darkness Aura (1/Day)
Actions.Description: Magical darkness fills a 15-foot Emanation originating from the darkmantle. This effect lasts while the darkmantle maintains Concentration on it, up to 10 minutes. Darkvision can't penetrate this area, and no light can illuminate it.

entities.name: Death Dog
entities.description:
*Medium Monstrosity, Neutral Evil*
AC 12 (natural armor), HP 39 (6d8 + 12)

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The death dog makes two Bite attacks.

Actions.Name: Bite
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12. First Failure The target has the Poisoned condition. While Poisoned, the target's Hit Point maximum doesn't return to normal when finishing a Long Rest, and it repeats the save every 24 hours that elapse, ending the effect on itself on a success. Subsequent Failures: The Poisoned target's Hit Point maximum decreases by 5 (1d10).

entities.name: Deer
entities.description:
*Medium Beast, Unaligned*
AC 13 (natural armor), HP 4 (1d8)

Traits.Name: Agile
Traits.Description: The deer doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it moves out of an enemy's reach.

Actions.Name: Ram
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. 2 (1d4) Bludgeoning damage.

entities.name: Deva
entities.description:
*Medium Celestial, Lawful Good*
AC 17 (natural armor), HP 229 (27d8 + 108)

Traits.Name: Exalted Restoration
Traits.Description: If the deva dies outside Mount Celestia, its body disappears, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in Mount Celestia.

Traits.Name: Magic Resistance
Traits.Description: The deva has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The deva makes two Holy Mace attacks.

Actions.Name: Holy Mace
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. 7 (1d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) Radiant damage.

Actions.Name: Spellcasting
Actions.Description:
The deva casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

- At Will: Detect Evil and Good, Shapechange
- 1/Day Each: Commune, Raise Dead

Bonus Actions.Name: Divine Aid (2/Day)
Bonus Actions.Description: The deva casts Cure Wounds, Lesser Restoration, or Remove Curse, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

entities.name: Dire Wolf
entities.description:
*Large Beast, Unaligned*
AC 14 (natural armor), HP 22 (3d10 + 6)

Traits.Name: Pack Tactics
Traits.Description: The wolf has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

Actions.Name: Bite
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 8 (1d10 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

entities.name: Djinni
entities.description:
*Large Elemental, Chaotic Good*
AC 17 (natural armor), HP 218 (19d10 + 114)

Traits.Name: Elemental Restoration
Traits.Description: If the djinni dies outside the Elemental Plane of Air, its body dissolves into mist, and it gains a new body in 1d4 days, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere on the Plane of Air.

Traits.Name: Magic Resistance
Traits.Description: The djinni has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Traits.Name: Wishes
Traits.Description: The djinni has a 30 percent chance of knowing the Wish spell. If the djinni knows it, the djinni can cast it only on behalf of a non-genie creature who communicates a wish in a way the djinni can understand. If the djinni casts the spell for the creature, the djinni suffers none of the spell's stress. Once the djinni has cast it three times, the djinni can't do so again for 365 days.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The djinni makes three attacks, using Storm Blade or Storm Bolt in any combination.

Actions.Name: Storm Blade
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 feet. 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Lightning damage.

Actions.Name: Storm Bolt
Actions.Description: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 120 feet. 13 (3d8) Thunder damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

Actions.Name: Create Whirlwind
Actions.Description: The djinni conjures a whirlwind at a point it can see within 120 feet. The whirlwind fills a 20-foot-radius, 60-foot-high Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder centered on that point. The whirlwind lasts until the djinni's Concentration on it ends. The djinni can move the whirlwind up to 20 feet at the start of each of its turns. Whenever the whirlwind enters a creature's space or a creature enters the whirlwind, that creature is subjected to the following effect. Strength Saving Throw: DC 17 (a creature makes this save only once per turn, and the djinni is unaffected). Failure: While in the whirlwind, the target has the Restrained condition and moves with the whirlwind. At the start of each of its turns, the Restrained target takes 21 (6d6) Thunder damage. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Actions.Name: Spellcasting
Actions.Description:
The djinni casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

- At Will: Detect Evil and Good, Detect Magic
- 2/Day Each: Create Food and Water, Tongues, Wind Walk
- 1/Day Each: Creation, Gaseous Form, Invisibility, Major Image, Plane Shift

entities.name: Doppelganger
entities.description:
*Medium Monstrosity, Neutral*
AC 14 (natural armor), HP 52 (8d8 + 16)

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The doppelganger makes two Slam attacks and uses Unsettling Visage if available.

Actions.Name: Slam
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +6 (with Advantage during the first round of each combat), reach 5 ft. 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

Actions.Name: Unsettling Visage (Recharge 6)
Actions.Description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from the doppelganger that can see the doppelganger. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

Actions.Name: Read Thoughts
Actions.Description:
The doppelganger casts Detect Thoughts, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12).

- At Will: Detect Thoughts

Bonus Actions.Name: Shape-Shift
Bonus Actions.Description: The doppelganger shape-shifts into a Medium or Small Humanoid, or it returns to its true form. Its game statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

entities.name: Draft Horse
entities.description:
*Large Beast, Unaligned*
AC 10 (natural armor), HP 15 (2d10 + 4)

Actions.Name: Hooves
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 6 (1d4 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

entities.name: Dragon Turtle
entities.description:
*Gargantuan Dragon, Neutral*
AC 20 (natural armor), HP 356 (23d20 + 115)

Traits.Name: Amphibious
Traits.Description: The dragon can breathe air and water.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The dragon makes three Bite attacks. It can replace one attack with a Tail attack.

Actions.Name: Bite
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +13, reach 15 ft. 23 (3d10 + 7) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Fire damage. Being underwater doesn't grant Resistance to this Fire damage.

Actions.Name: Tail
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +13, reach 15 ft. 18 (2d10 + 7) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

Actions.Name: Steam Breath (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.Description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 19, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. Failure: 56 (16d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: Being underwater doesn't grant Resistance to this Fire damage.

entities.name: Dretch
entities.description:
*Small Fiend, Chaotic Evil*
AC 11 (natural armor), HP 18 (4d6 + 4)

Basics.Languages: Abyssal; telepathy 60 ft. (works only with creatures that understand Abyssal)

Actions.Name: Rend
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. 4 (1d6 + 1) Slashing damage.

Actions.Name: Fetid Cloud (1/Day)
Actions.Description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the dretch. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn. While Poisoned, the creature can take either an action or a Bonus Action on its turn, not both, and it can't take Reactions.

entities.name: Drider
entities.description:
*Large Monstrosity, Chaotic Evil*
AC 19 (natural armor), HP 123 (13d10 + 52)

Traits.Name: Spider Climb
Traits.Description: The drider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

Traits.Name: Sunlight Sensitivity
Traits.Description: While in sunlight, the drider has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

Traits.Name: Web Walker
Traits.Description: The drider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the drider knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The drider makes three attacks, using Foreleg or Poison Burst in any combination.

Actions.Name: Foreleg
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage.

Actions.Name: Poison Burst
Actions.Description: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 120 ft. 13 (3d6 + 3) Poison damage.

Bonus Actions.Name: Magic of the Spider Queen (Recharge 5-6)
Bonus Actions.Description: The drider casts Darkness, Faerie Fire, or Web, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14).

entities.name: Druid
entities.description:
*Small Humanoid, Neutral*
AC 13 (natural armor), HP 44 (8d8 + 8)

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The druid makes two attacks, using Vine Staff or Verdant Wisp in any combination.

Actions.Name: Vine Staff
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage.

Actions.Name: Verdant Wisp
Actions.Description: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 90 ft. 10 (3d6) Radiant damage.

Actions.Name: Spellcasting
Actions.Description:
The druid casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

- At Will: Druidcraft, Speak with Animals
- 2/Day Each: Entangle, Thunderwave
- 1/Day Each: Animal Messenger, Longstrider, Moonbeam

entities.name: Dryad
entities.description:
*Medium Fey, Neutral*
AC 16 (natural armor), HP 22 (5d8)

Traits.Name: Magic Resistance
Traits.Description: The dryad has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Traits.Name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
Traits.Description: The dryad can communicate with Beasts and Plants as if they shared a language.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The dryad makes one Vine Lash or Thorn Burst attack, and it can use Spellcasting to cast Charm Monster.

Actions.Name: Vine Lash
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. 8 (1d8 + 4) Slashing damage.

Actions.Name: Thorn Burst
Actions.Description: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 60 ft. 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage.

Actions.Name: Spellcasting
Actions.Description:
The dryad casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

- At Will: Animal Friendship, Charm Monster, Druidcraft
- 1/Day Each: Entangle, Pass without Trace

Bonus Actions.Name: Tree Stride
Bonus Actions.Description: If within 5 feet of a Large or bigger tree, the dryad teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of a second Large or bigger tree that is within 60 feet of the previous tree.

entities.name: Dust Mephit
entities.description:
*Small Elemental, Neutral Evil*
AC 12 (natural armor), HP 17 (5d6)

Traits.Name: Death Burst
Traits.Description: The mephit explodes when it dies. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the mephit. Failure: 5 (2d4) Bludgeoning damage. Success: Half damage.

Actions.Name: Claw
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 4 (1d4 + 2) Slashing damage.

Actions.Name: Blinding Breath (Recharge 6)
Actions.Description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: The target has the Blinded condition until the end of the mephit's next turn.

Actions.Name: Sleep (1/Day)
Actions.Description: The mephit casts the Sleep spell, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 10).

entities.name: Eagle
entities.description:
*Small Beast, Unaligned*
AC 12 (natural armor), HP 4 (1d6 + 1)

Actions.Name: Talons
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 feet. 4 (1d4 + 2) Slashing damage.

entities.name: Earth Elemental
entities.description:
*Large Elemental, Neutral*
AC 17 (natural armor), HP 147 (14d10 + 70)

Basics.Immunities: Poison; Exhaustion, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Unconscious

Traits.Name: Earth Glide
Traits.Description: The elemental can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the elemental doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

Traits.Name: Siege Monster
Traits.Description: The elemental deals double damage to objects and structures.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The elemental makes two attacks, using Slam or Rock Launch in any combination.

Actions.Name: Slam
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. 14 (2d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage.

Actions.Name: Rock Launch
Actions.Description: Ranged Attack Roll: +8, range 60 ft. 8 (1d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

entities.name: Efreeti
entities.description:
*Large Elemental, Neutral*
AC 17 (natural armor), HP 212 (17d10 + 119)

Traits.Name: Elemental Restoration
Traits.Description: If the efreeti dies outside the Elemental Plane of Fire, its body dissolves into ash, and it gains a new body in 1d4 days, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere on the Plane of Fire.

Traits.Name: Magic Resistance
Traits.Description: The efreeti has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Traits.Name: Wishes
Traits.Description: The efreeti has a 30 percent chance of knowing the Wish spell. If the efreeti knows it, the efreeti can cast it only on behalf of a non-genie creature who communicates a wish in a way the efreeti can understand. If the efreeti casts the spell for the creature, the efreeti suffers none of the spell's stress. Once the efreeti has cast it three times, the efreeti can't do so again for 365 days.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The efreeti makes three attacks, using Heated Blade or Hurl Flame in any combination.

Actions.Name: Heated Blade
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. 13 (2d6 + 6) Slashing damage plus 13 (2d12) Fire damage.

Actions.Name: Hurl Flame
Actions.Description: Ranged Attack Roll: +8, range 120 ft. 24 (7d6) Fire damage.

Actions.Name: Spellcasting
Actions.Description:
The efreeti casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):

- At Will: Detect Magic, Elementalism
- 1/Day Each: Gaseous Form, Invisibility, Major Image, Plane Shift, Tongues, Wall of Fire

entities.name: Elephant
entities.description:
*Huge Beast, Unaligned*
AC 12 (natural armor), HP 76 (8d12 + 24)

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The elephant makes two Gore attacks.

Actions.Name: Gore
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. 15 (2d8 + 6) Piercing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature and the elephant moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target has the Prone condition.

Bonus Actions.Name: Trample
Bonus Actions.Description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature within 5 feet that has the Prone condition. Failure: 17 (2d10 + 6) Bludgeoning damage. Success: Half damage.

entities.name: Elk
entities.description:
*Large Beast, Unaligned*
AC 10 (natural armor), HP 11 (2d10)

Actions.Name: Ram
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 6 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the elk moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage and has the Prone condition.

entities.name: Erinyes
entities.description:
*Medium Fiend, Lawful Evil*
AC 18 (natural armor), HP 178 (21d8 + 84)

Traits.Name: Diabolical Restoration
Traits.Description: If the erinyes dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.

Traits.Name: Magic Resistance
Traits.Description: The erinyes has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Traits.Name: Magic Rope
Traits.Description: The erinyes has a magic rope. While bearing it, the erinyes can use the Entangling Rope action. The rope has AC 20, HP 90, and Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. The rope turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points, if it is 5+ feet away from the erinyes for 1 hour or more, or if the erinyes dies. If the rope is damaged or destroyed, the erinyes can fully restore it when finishing a Short Rest|XPHB|Short or Long Rest.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The erinyes makes three Withering Sword attacks and can use Entangling Rope.

Actions.Name: Withering Sword
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage.

Actions.Name: Entangling Rope (Requires Magic Rope)
Actions.Description: Strength Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the erinyes can see within 120 feet. Failure: 14 (4d6) Force damage, and the target has the Restrained condition until the rope is destroyed, the erinyes uses a Bonus Action to release the target, or the erinyes uses Entangling Rope again.

Reactions.Name: Parry
Reactions.Description: _Trigger:_ The erinyes is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. _Response:_ The erinyes adds 4 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

entities.name: Ettercap
entities.description:
*Medium Monstrosity, Neutral Evil*
AC 13 (natural armor), HP 44 (8d8 + 8)

Traits.Name: Spider Climb
Traits.Description: The ettercap can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

Traits.Name: Web Walker
Traits.Description: The ettercap ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the ettercap knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The ettercap makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

Actions.Name: Bite
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the ettercap's next turn.

Actions.Name: Claw
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 7 (2d4 + 2) Slashing damage.

Actions.Name: Web Strand (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.Description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12, one Large or smaller creature the ettercap can see within 30 feet. Failure: The target has the Restrained condition until the web is destroyed (AC 10; HP 5; Vulnerability to Fire damage; Immunity to Bludgeoning, Poison, and Psychic damage).

Bonus Actions.Name: Reel
Bonus Actions.Description: The ettercap pulls one creature within 30 feet of itself that is Restrained by its Web Strand up to 25 feet straight toward itself.

entities.name: Ettin
entities.description:
*Large Giant, Chaotic Evil*
AC 12 (natural armor), HP 85 (10d10 + 30)

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The ettin makes one Battleaxe attack and one Morningstar attack.

Actions.Name: Battleaxe
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. 14 (2d8 + 5) Slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

Actions.Name: Morningstar
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. 14 (2d8 + 5) Piercing damage, and the target has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

entities.name: Fire Elemental
entities.description:
*Large Elemental, Neutral*
AC 13 (natural armor), HP 93 (11d10 + 33)

Basics.Immunities: Fire, Poison; Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious

Traits.Name: Fire Aura
Traits.Description: At the end of each of the elemental's turns, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the elemental takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage. Creatures and flammable objects in the Emanation start Hitazard burning.

Traits.Name: Fire Form
Traits.Description: The elemental can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so, and it can enter a creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage.

Traits.Name: Illumination
Traits.Description: The elemental sheds Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet.

Traits.Name: Water Susceptibility
Traits.Description: The elemental takes 3 (1d6) Cold damage for every 5 feet the elemental moves in water or for every gallon of water splashed on it.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The elemental makes two Burn attacks.

Actions.Name: Burn
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 10 (2d6 + 3) Fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object, it starts burning.

entities.name: Fire Giant
entities.description:
*Huge Giant, Lawful Evil*
AC 18 (natural armor), HP 162 (13d12 + 78)

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The giant makes two attacks, using Flame Sword or Hammer Throw in any combination.

Actions.Name: Flame Sword
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 10 ft. 21 (4d6 + 7) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage.

Actions.Name: Hammer Throw
Actions.Description: Ranged Attack Roll: +11, range 60/240 ft. 23 (3d10 + 7) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) Fire damage, and the target is pushed up to 15 feet straight away from the giant and has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

entities.name: Flesh Golem
entities.description:
*Medium Construct, Neutral*
AC 9 (natural armor), HP 127 (15d8 + 60)

Basics.Immunities: Lightning, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
Basics.Languages: Understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

Traits.Name: Aversion to Fire
Traits.Description: If the golem takes Fire damage, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

Traits.Name: Berserk
Traits.Description: Whenever the golem starts its turn Bloodied, roll 1d6. On a 6, the golem goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the golem attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the golem attacks an object. Once the golem goes berserk, it remains so until it is destroyed or it is no longer Bloodied. The golem's creator, if within 60 feet of the berserk golem, can try to calm it by taking an action to make a DC 15 Charisma (Persuasion) check; the golem must be able to hear its creator. If this check succeeds, the golem ceases being berserk until the start of its next turn, at which point it resumes rolling for the Berserk trait again if it is still Bloodied.

Traits.Name: Immutable Form
Traits.Description: The golem can't shape-shift.

Traits.Name: Lightning Absorption
Traits.Description: Whenever the golem is subjected to Lightning damage, it regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Lightning damage dealt.

Traits.Name: Magic Resistance
Traits.Description: The golem has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The golem makes two Slam attacks.

Actions.Name: Slam
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) Lightning damage.

entities.name: Flying Snake
entities.description:
*Small Monstrosity, Unaligned*
AC 14 (natural armor), HP 5 (2d4)

Traits.Name: Flyby
Traits.Description: The snake doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

Actions.Name: Bite
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 1 Piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) Poison damage.

entities.name: Frog
entities.description:
*Small Beast, Unaligned*
AC 11 (natural armor), HP 1 (1d4 - 1)

Traits.Name: Amphibious
Traits.Description: The frog can breathe air and water.

Traits.Name: Standing Leap
Traits.Description: The frog's Long Jump is up to 10 feet and its High Jump is up to 5 feet with or without a running start.

Actions.Name: Bite
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. 1 Piercing damage.

entities.name: Frost Giant
entities.description:
*Huge Giant, Neutral Evil*
AC 15 (natural armor), HP 149 (13d12 + 65)

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The giant makes two attacks, using Frost Axe or Great Bow in any combination.

Actions.Name: Frost Axe
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. 19 (2d12 + 6) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Cold damage.

Actions.Name: Great Bow
Actions.Description: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 150/600 ft. 17 (2d10 + 6) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Cold damage, and the target's Speed decreases by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

Bonus Actions.Name: War Cry (Recharge 5-6)
Bonus Actions.Description: The giant or one creature of its choice that can see or hear it gains 16 (2d10 + 5) Temporary Hit Points and has Advantage on attack rolls until the start of the giant's next turn.

entities.name: Gargoyle
entities.description:
*Medium Elemental, Chaotic Evil*
AC 15 (natural armor), HP 67 (9d8 + 27)

Traits.Name: Flyby
Traits.Description: The gargoyle doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The gargoyle makes two Claw attacks.

Actions.Name: Claw
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 7 (2d4 + 2) Slashing damage.

entities.name: Gelatinous Cube
entities.description:
*Large Ooze, Unaligned*
AC 6 (natural armor), HP 63 (6d10 + 30)

Basics.Immunities: Acid; Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Prone

Traits.Name: Ooze Cube
Traits.Description: The cube fills its entire space and is transparent. Other creatures can enter that space, but a creature that does so is subjected to the cube's Engulf and has Disadvantage on the saving throw. Creatures inside the cube have Cover|XPHB|Total Cover, and the cube can hold one Large creature or up to four Medium or Small creatures inside itself at a time. As an action, a creature within 5 feet of the cube can pull a creature or an object out of the cube by succeeding on a DC 12 Strength (Athletics) check, and the puller takes 10 (3d6) Acid damage.

Traits.Name: Transparent
Traits.Description: Even when the cube is in plain sight, a creature must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to notice the cube if the creature hasn't witnessed the cube move or otherwise act.

Actions.Name: Pseudopod
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 12 (3d6 + 2) Acid damage.

Actions.Name: Engulf
Actions.Description: The cube moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. The cube can move through the spaces of Large or smaller creatures if it has room inside itself to contain them (see the Ooze Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube trait). Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature whose space the cube enters for the first time during this move. Failure: 10 (3d6) Acid damage, and the target is engulfed. An engulfed target is suffocating, can't cast spells with a Verbal component, has the Restrained condition, and takes 10 (3d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the cube's turns. When the cube moves, the engulfed target moves with it. An engulfed target can try to escape by taking an action to make a DC 12 Strength (Athletics) check. On a successful check, the target escapes and enters the nearest unoccupied space. Success: Half damage, and the target moves to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the cube. If there is no unoccupied space, the target fails the save instead.

entities.name: Ghast
entities.description:
*Medium Undead, Chaotic Evil*
AC 13 (natural armor), HP 36 (8d8)

Traits.Name: Stench
Traits.Description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10, any creature that starts its turn in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the ghast. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition until the start of its next turn. Success: The target is immune to this ghast's Stench for 24 hours.

Actions.Name: Bite
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage.

Actions.Name: Claw
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage. If the target is a non-Undead creature, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10. Failure: The target has the Paralyzed condition until the end of its next turn.

entities.name: Ghost
entities.description:
*Medium Undead, Neutral*
AC 11 (natural armor), HP 45 (10d8)

Basics.Immunities: Necrotic, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained

Traits.Name: Ethereal Sight
Traits.Description: The ghost can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane.

Traits.Name: Incorporeal Movement
Traits.Description: The ghost can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The ghost makes two Withering Touch attacks.

Actions.Name: Withering Touch
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 19 (3d10 + 3) Necrotic damage.

Actions.Name: Horrific Visage
Actions.Description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 60-foot Cone that can see the ghost and isn't an Undead. Failure: 10 (2d6 + 3) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of the ghost's next turn. Success: The target is immune to this ghost's Horrific Visage for 24 hours.

Actions.Name: Possession (Recharge 6)
Actions.Description: Charisma Saving Throw: DC 13, one Humanoid the ghost can see within 5 feet. Failure: The target is possessed by the ghost; the ghost disappears, and the target has the Incapacitated condition and loses control of its body. The ghost now controls the body, but the target retains awareness. The ghost can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that specifically target Undead. The ghost's game statistics are the same, except it uses the possessed target's Speed, as well as the target's Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution modifiers. The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 Hit Points or the ghost leaves as a Bonus Action. When the possession ends, the ghost appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target, and the target is immune to this ghost's Possession for 24 hours. Success: The target is immune to this ghost's Possession for 24 hours.

Actions.Name: Etherealness
Actions.Description:
The ghost casts the Etherealness spell, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability. The ghost is visible on the Material Plane while on the Border Ethereal and vice versa, but it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

- At Will: Etherealness

entities.name: Ghoul
entities.description:
*Medium Undead, Chaotic Evil*
AC 12 (natural armor), HP 22 (5d8)

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The ghoul makes two Bite attacks.

Actions.Name: Bite
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Necrotic damage.

Actions.Name: Claw
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 4 (1d4 + 2) Slashing damage. If the target is a creature that isn't an Undead or elf, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10. Failure: The target has the Paralyzed condition until the end of its next turn.

entities.name: Giant Ape
entities.description:
*Huge Beast, Unaligned*
AC 12 (natural armor), HP 168 (16d12 + 64)

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The ape makes two Fist attacks.

Actions.Name: Fist
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. 22 (3d10 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.

Actions.Name: Boulder Toss (Recharge 6)
Actions.Description: The ape hurls a boulder at a point it can see within 90 feet. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature in a 5-foot-radius Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere centered on that point. Failure: 24 (7d6) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only.

Bonus Actions.Name: Leap
Bonus Actions.Description: The ape jumps up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.

entities.name: Giant Badger
entities.description:
*Medium Beast, Unaligned*
AC 13 (natural armor), HP 15 (2d8 + 6)

Actions.Name: Bite
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. 6 (2d4 + 1) Piercing damage.

entities.name: Giant Bat
entities.description:
*Large Beast, Unaligned*
AC 13 (natural armor), HP 22 (4d10)

Actions.Name: Bite
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

entities.name: Giant Boar
entities.description:
*Large Beast, Unaligned*
AC 13 (natural armor), HP 42 (5d10 + 15)

Traits.Name: Bloodied Fury
Traits.Description: The boar has Advantage on melee attack rolls while it is Bloodied.

Actions.Name: Gore
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the boar moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) Piercing damage and has the Prone condition.

entities.name: Giant Centipede
entities.description:
*Small Beast, Unaligned*
AC 14 (natural armor), HP 9 (2d6 + 2)

Actions.Name: Bite

entities.name: Guardian Naga
entities.description:
*Large Celestial, Lawful Good*
AC 18 (natural armor), HP 136 (16d10 + 48)

Traits.Name: Celestial Restoration
Traits.Description: If the naga dies, it returns to life in 1d6 days and regains all its Hit Points unless Dispel Evil and Good is cast on its remains.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The naga makes two Bite attacks. It can replace any attack with a use of Poisonous Spittle.

Actions.Name: Bite
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. 17 (2d12 + 4) Piercing damage plus 22 (4d10) Poison damage.

Actions.Name: Poisonous Spittle
Actions.Description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the naga can see within 60 feet. Failure: 31 (7d8) Poison damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the start of the naga's next turn. Success: Half damage only.

Actions.Name: Spellcasting
Actions.Description:
The naga casts one of the following spells, requiring no Somatic or Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):

- At Will: Thaumaturgy
- 1/Day Each: Clairvoyance, Cure Wounds, Flame Strike, Geas, True Seeing

entities.name: Half-Dragon
entities.description:
*Medium Dragon, Neutral*
AC 18 (natural armor), HP 105 (14d8 + 42)

Traits.Name: Draconic Origin
Traits.Description: The half-dragon is related to a type of dragon associated with one of the following damage types (DM's choice): Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison. This choice affects other aspects of the stat block.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The half-dragon makes two Claw attacks.

Actions.Name: Claw
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. 6 (1d4 + 4) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) damage of the type chosen for the Draconic Origin trait.

Actions.Name: Dragon's Breath (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.Description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 28 (8d6) damage of the type chosen for the Draconic Origin trait. Success: Half damage.

Bonus Actions.Name: Leap
Bonus Actions.Description: The half-dragon jumps up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.

entities.name: Harpy
entities.description:
*Medium Monstrosity, Chaotic Evil*
AC 11 (natural armor), HP 38 (7d8 + 7)

Actions.Name: Claw
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. 6 (2d4 + 1) Slashing damage.

Actions.Name: Luring Song
Actions.Description: The harpy sings a magical melody, which lasts until the harpy's Concentration ends on it. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 11, each Humanoid and Giant in a 300-foot Emanation originating from the harpy when the song starts. Failure: The target has the Charmed condition until the song ends and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. While Charmed, the target has the Incapacitated condition and ignores the Luring Song of other harpies. If the target is more than 5 feet from the harpy, the target moves on its turn toward the harpy by the most direct route, trying to get within 5 feet of the harpy. It doesn't avoid Opportunity Attacks; however, before moving into damaging terrain (such as lava or a pit) and whenever it takes damage from a source other than the harpy, the target repeats the save. Success: The target is immune to this harpy's Luring Song for 24 hours.

entities.name: Hawk
entities.description:
*Small Beast, Unaligned*
AC 13 (natural armor), HP 1 (1d4 - 1)

Actions.Name: Talons
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 1 Slashing damage.

entities.name: Hell Hound
entities.description:
*Medium Fiend, Lawful Evil*
AC 15 (natural armor), HP 58 (9d8 + 18)

Traits.Name: Pack Tactics
Traits.Description: The hound has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the hound's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The hound makes two Bite attacks.

Actions.Name: Bite
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

Actions.Name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.Description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 17 (5d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

entities.name: Hezrou
entities.description:

AC 18 (natural armor), HP 157 (15d10 + 75)

Traits.Name: Demonic Restoration
Traits.Description: If the hezrou dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

entities.name: Hill Giant

entities.description:

AC 18 (natural armor), HP 11 (2d8 + 2)

Traits.Name: Pack Tactics
Traits.Description: The hobgoblin has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the hobgoblin's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

Actions.Name: Longsword
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. 12 (2d10 + 1) Slashing damage.

Actions.Name: Longbow
Actions.Description: Ranged Attack Roll: +3, range 150/600 ft. 5 (1d8 + 1) Piercing damage plus 7 (3d4) Poison damage.

entities.name: Homunculus
entities.description:
*Small Construct, Neutral*
AC 13 (natural armor), HP 4 (1d4 + 2)

Basics.Languages: Understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

Traits.Name: Telepathic Bond
Traits.Description: While the homunculus is on the same plane of existence as its master, the two of them can communicate telepathically with each other.

Actions.Name: Bite
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 1 Piercing damage, and the target is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition until the end of the homunculus's next turn. Failure by 5 or More: The target has the Poisoned condition for 1 minute. While Poisoned, the target has the Unconscious condition, which ends early if the target takes any damage.

entities.name: Horned Devil
entities.description:
*Large Fiend, Lawful Evil*
AC 18 (natural armor), HP 199 (19d10 + 95)

Traits.Name: Diabolical Restoration
Traits.Description: If the devil dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.

Traits.Name: Magic Resistance
Traits.Description: The devil has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The devil makes three attacks, using Searing Fork or Hurl Flame in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Infernal Tail.

Actions.Name: Searing Fork
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. 15 (2d8 + 6) Piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) Fire damage.

Actions.Name: Hurl Flame
Actions.Description: Ranged Attack Roll: +8, range 150 ft. 26 (5d8 + 4) Fire damage. If the target is a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it starts burning.

Actions.Name: Infernal Tail
Actions.Description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, one creature the devil can see within 10 feet. Failure: 10 (1d8 + 6) Necrotic damage, and the target receives an infernal wound if it doesn't have one. While wounded, the target loses 10 (3d6) Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. The wound closes after 1 minute, after a spell restores Hit Points to the target, or after the target or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to stanch the wound, doing so by succeeding on a DC 17 Wisdom (Medicine) check.

entities.name: Hunter Shark
entities.description:
*Large Beast, Unaligned*
AC 12 (natural armor), HP 45 (6d10 + 12)

Traits.Description: The shark can breathe only underwater.

Actions.Name: Bite
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +6 (with Advantage if the target doesn't have all its Hit Points), reach 5 ft. 14 (3d6 + 4) Piercing damage.

entities.name: Hydra
entities.description:
*Huge Monstrosity, Unaligned*
AC 15 (natural armor), HP 184 (16d12 + 80)

Traits.Name: Hold Breath
Traits.Description: The hydra can hold its breath for 1 hour.

Traits.Name: Multiple Heads
Traits.Description: The hydra has five heads. Whenever the hydra takes 25 damage or more on a single turn, one of its heads dies. The hydra dies if all its heads are dead. At the end of each of its turns when it has at least one living head, the hydra grows two heads for each of its heads that died since its last turn, unless it has taken Fire damage since its last turn. The hydra regains 20 Hit Points when it grows new heads.

Traits.Name: Reactive Heads
Traits.Description: For each head the hydra has beyond one, it gets an extra Reaction that can be used only for Opportunity Attacks.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The hydra makes as many Bite attacks as it has heads.

Actions.Name: Bite
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. 10 (1d10 + 5) Piercing damage.

entities.name: Hyena
entities.description:
*Medium Beast, Unaligned*
AC 11 (natural armor), HP 5 (1d8 + 1)

Traits.Name: Pack Tactics
Traits.Description: The hyena has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the hyena's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

Actions.Name: Bite
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. 3 (1d6) Piercing damage.

entities.name: Ice Devil

Traits.Description: The devil has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Actions.Description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. 14 (2d8 + 5) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Cold damage. Until the end of its next turn, the target can't take a Bonus Action or Reaction, its Speed decreases by 10 feet, and it can move or take one action on its turn, not both. HitomThe spear magically returns to the devil's hand immediately after a ranged attack.

Actions.Name: Tail
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. 15 (3d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) Cold damage.

The devil casts Wall of Ice (level 8 version), requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17).

*Small Elemental, Neutral Evil*
AC 11 (natural armor), HP 21 (6d6)

Traits.Name: Death Burst
Traits.Description: The mephit explodes when it dies. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the mephit. Failure: 5 (2d4) Cold damage. Success: Half damage.

Actions.Name: Claw
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. 3 (1d4 + 1) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Cold damage.

- 1/Day Each: Fog Cloud

entities.name: Imp
entities.description:
*Small Fiend, Lawful Evil*
AC 13 (natural armor), HP 21 (6d4 + 6)

Traits.Name: Magic Resistance
Traits.Description: The imp has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Actions.Name: Sting
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

Actions.Name: Shape-Shift
Actions.Description: The imp shape-shifts to resemble a rat (Speed 20 ft.), a raven (20 ft., Fly 60 ft.), or a spider (20 ft., Climb 20 ft.), or it returns to its true form. Its statistics are the same in each form, except for its Speed. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

Actions.Name: Invisibility
Actions.Description:
The imp casts Invisibility on itself, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.

- At Will: Invisibility

entities.name: Incubus
entities.description:
*Medium Fiend, Neutral Evil*
AC 15 (natural armor), HP 66 (12d8 + 12)

Traits.Name: Succubus Form
Traits.Description: When the incubus finishes a Long Rest, it can shape-shift into a Succubus, using that stat block instead of this one. Any equipment it's wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The incubus makes two Restless Touch attacks.

Actions.Name: Restless Touch
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. 15 (3d6 + 5) Psychic damage, and the target is cursed for 24 hours or until the incubus dies. Until the curse ends, the target gains no benefit from finishing Short Rests.

Actions.Name: Spellcasting
Actions.Description:
The incubus casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

- At Will: Disguise Self, Etherealness
- 1/Day Each: Dream, Hypnotic Pattern

Bonus Actions.Name: Nightmare (Recharge 6)
Bonus Actions.Description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15, one creature the incubus can see within 60 feet. Failure: If the target has 20 Hit Points or fewer, it has the Unconscious condition for 1 hour, until it takes damage, or until a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to wake it. Otherwise, the target takes 18 (4d8) Psychic damage.

entities.name: Invisible Stalker
entities.description:
*Large Elemental, Neutral*
AC 14 (natural armor), HP 97 (13d10 + 26)

Basics.Immunities: Poison; Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious

Traits.Name: Air Form
Traits.Description: The stalker can enter an enemy's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

Traits.Name: Invisibility
Traits.Description: The stalker has the Invisible condition.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The stalker makes three Wind Swipe attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Vortex.

Actions.Name: Wind Swipe
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. 11 (2d6 + 4) Force damage.

Actions.Name: Vortex
Actions.Description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, one Large or smaller creature in the stalker's space. Failure: 7 (1d8 + 3) Thunder damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13). Until the grapple ends, the target can't cast spells with a Verbal component and takes 7 (2d6) Thunder damage at the start of each of the stalker's turns.

entities.name: Iron Golem

Basics.Languages: Understands Common plus two other languages but can't speak

Traits.Name: Immutable Form
Traits.Description: The golem can't shape-shift.

Traits.Name: Magic Resistance
Traits.Description: The golem has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Actions.Name: Multiattack

Actions.Name: Bladed Arm
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 10 ft. 20 (3d8 + 7) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage.

Actions.Description: Ranged Attack Roll: +10, range 120 ft. 36 (8d8) Fire damage.

Actions.Name: Poison Breath (Recharge 6)
Actions.Description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. Failure: 55 (10d10) Poison damage. Success: Half damage.

entities.name: Jackal
entities.description:
*Small Beast, Unaligned*
AC 12 (natural armor), HP 3 (1d6)

Actions.Name: Bite
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +1, reach 5 ft. 1 (1d4 - 1) Piercing damage.

entities.name: Killer Whale
entities.description:
*Huge Beast, Unaligned*
AC 12 (natural armor), HP 90 (12d12 + 12)

Traits.Name: Hold Breath
Traits.Description: The whale can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

Actions.Name: Bite
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 21 (5d6 + 4) Piercing damage.

entities.name: Knight
entities.description:
*Small Humanoid, Neutral*
AC 18 (natural armor), HP 52 (8d8 + 16)

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The knight makes two attacks, using Greatsword or Heavy Crossbow in any combination.

Actions.Name: Greatsword
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) Radiant damage.

Actions.Name: Heavy Crossbow
Actions.Description: Ranged Attack Roll: +2, range 100/400 ft. 11 (2d10) Piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) Radiant damage.

Reactions.Name: Parry
Reactions.Description: _Trigger:_ The knight is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. _Response:_ The knight adds 2 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

entities.name: Kobold Warrior
entities.description:
*Small Dragon, Neutral*
AC 14 (natural armor), HP 7 (3d6 - 3)

Traits.Name: Pack Tactics
Traits.Description: The kobold has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kobold's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

Traits.Name: Sunlight Sensitivity
Traits.Description: While in sunlight, the kobold has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

Actions.Name: Dagger
Actions.Description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage.

Attacks.Name: Dagger
Attacks.Reach: Melee or Ranged, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft.

entities.name: Kraken
entities.description:
*Gargantuan Monstrosity, Chaotic Evil*
AC 18 (natural armor), HP 481 (26d20 + 208)

Basics.Immunities: Cold, Lightning; Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Restrained
Basics.Languages: Understands Abyssal, Celestial, Infernal, And Primordial but can't speak; telepathy 120 ft.

Traits.Name: Amphibious
Traits.Description: The kraken can breathe air and water.

Traits.Name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Lair)
Traits.Description: If the kraken fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Traits.Name: Siege Monster
Traits.Description: The kraken deals double damage to objects and structures.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The kraken makes two Tentacle attacks and uses Fling, Lightning Strike, or Swallow.

Actions.Name: Tentacle
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +17, reach 30 ft. 24 (4d6 + 10) Bludgeoning damage. The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 20) from one of ten tentacles, and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

Actions.Name: Fling
Actions.Description: The kraken throws a Large or smaller creature Grappled by it to a space it can see within 60 feet of itself that isn't in the air. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 25, the creature thrown and each creature in the destination space. Failure: 18 (4d8) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only.

Actions.Name: Lightning Strike
Actions.Description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 23, one creature the kraken can see within 120 feet. Failure: 33 (6d10) Lightning damage. Success: Half damage.

Actions.Name: Swallow
Actions.Description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 25, one creature Grappled by the kraken (it can have up to four creatures swallowed at a time). Failure: 23 (3d8 + 10) Piercing damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it is swallowed and no longer Grappled. A swallowed creature has the Restrained condition, has Cover|XPHB|Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the kraken, and takes 24 (7d6) Acid damage at the start of each of its turns. If the kraken takes 50 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the kraken must succeed on a DC 25 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 10 feet of the kraken with the Prone condition. If the kraken dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

Legendary Actions.Name: Storm Bolt
Legendary Actions.Description: The kraken uses Lightning Strike.

Legendary Actions.Name: Toxic Ink
Legendary Actions.Description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 23, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from the kraken while it is underwater. Failure: The target has the Blinded and Poisoned conditions until the end of the kraken's next turn. The kraken then moves up to its Speed. Failure or Success: The kraken can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

Actions.Name: Claw
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Psychic damage.

Actions.Name: Corrupting Touch
Actions.Description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 13, one creature the lamia can see within 5 feet. Failure: 13 (3d8) Psychic damage, and the target is cursed for 1 hour. Until the curse ends, the target has the Charmed and Poisoned conditions.

- At Will: Disguise Self, Minor Illusion

entities.name: Lemure

Traits.Name: Hellish Restoration

Actions.Name: Vile Slime
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. 2 (1d4) Poison damage.

entities.name: Lich

*Medium Undead, Neutral Evil*
AC 20 (natural armor), HP 315 (42d8 + 126)

Basics.Immunities: Necrotic, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned

Traits.Name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Lair)
Traits.Description: If the lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Traits.Name: Spirit Jar
Traits.Description: If destroyed, the lich reforms in 1d10 days if it has a spirit jar, reviving with all its Hit Points. The new body appears in an unoccupied space within the lich's lair.
