Actions.Name: Eldritch Burst
Actions.Description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +12, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. 31 (4d12 + 5) Force damage.

Actions.Name: Paralyzing Touch
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 5 ft. 15 (3d6 + 5) Cold damage, and the target has the Paralyzed condition until the start of the lich's next turn.

Actions.Name: Spellcasting
Actions.Description:
The lich casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20):

- At Will: Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Dispel Magic, Fireball, Invisibility, Lightning Bolt, Mage Hand, Prestidigitation
- 2/Day Each: Animate Dead, Dimension Door, Plane Shift
- 1/Day Each: Chain Lightning, Finger of Death, Power Word Kill, Scrying

Reactions.Name: Protective Magic
Reactions.Description: The lich casts Counterspell or Shield in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

Legendary Actions.Name: Deathly Teleport
Legendary Actions.Description: The lich teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, and each creature within 10 feet of the space it left takes 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage.

Legendary Actions.Name: Disrupt Life
Legendary Actions.Description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20, each creature that isn't an Undead in a 20-foot Emanation originating from the lich. Failure: 31 (9d6) Necrotic damage. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: The lich can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

Legendary Actions.Name: Frightening Gaze
Legendary Actions.Description: The lich casts Fear, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. The lich can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

Attacks.Name: Eldritch Burst
Attacks.Reach: Melee or Ranged, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft.

entities.name: Lion
entities.description:
*Large Beast, Unaligned*
AC 12 (natural armor), HP 22 (4d10)

Traits.Name: Pack Tactics
Traits.Description: The lion has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the lion's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

Traits.Name: Running Leap
Traits.Description: With a 10-foot running start, the lion can Long Jump up to 25 feet.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The lion makes two Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Roar.

Actions.Name: Rend
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage.

Actions.Name: Roar
Actions.Description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 11, one creature within 15 feet. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition until the start of the lion's next turn.

entities.name: Lizard
entities.description:
*Small Beast, Unaligned*
AC 10 (natural armor), HP 2 (1d4)

Traits.Name: Spider Climb
Traits.Description: The lizard can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

Actions.Name: Bite
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. 1 Piercing damage.

entities.name: Mage
entities.description:
*Small Humanoid, Neutral*
AC 15 (natural armor), HP 81 (18d8)

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The mage makes three Arcane Burst attacks.

Actions.Name: Arcane Burst
Actions.Description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. 16 (3d8 + 3) Force damage.

Actions.Name: Spellcasting
Actions.Description:
The mage casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

- At Will: Detect Magic, Light, Mage Armor, Mage Hand, Prestidigitation
- 2/Day Each: Fireball, Invisibility
- 1/Day Each: Cone of Cold, Fly

Bonus Actions.Name: Misty Step (3/Day)
Bonus Actions.Description: The mage casts Misty Step, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

Reactions.Name: Protective Magic (3/Day)
Reactions.Description: The mage casts Counterspell or Shield in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

Attacks.Name: Arcane Burst
Attacks.Reach: Melee or Ranged, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft.

entities.name: Magma Mephit
entities.description:
*Small Elemental, Neutral Evil*
AC 11 (natural armor), HP 18 (4d6 + 4)

Traits.Name: Death Burst
Traits.Description: The mephit explodes when it dies. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the mephit. Failure: 7 (2d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

Actions.Name: Claw
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. 3 (1d4 + 1) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

Actions.Name: Fire Breath (Recharge 6)
Actions.Description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 7 (2d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

entities.name: Magmin
entities.description:
*Small Elemental, Chaotic Neutral*
AC 14 (natural armor), HP 13 (3d6 + 3)

Traits.Name: Death Burst
Traits.Description: The magmin explodes when it dies. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the magmin. Failure: 7 (2d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

Actions.Name: Touch
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 7 (2d4 + 2) Fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it starts burning.

Bonus Actions.Name: Ignited Illumination
Bonus Actions.Description: The magmin sets itself ablaze or extinguishes its flames. While ablaze, the magmin sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet.

entities.name: Mammoth
entities.description:
*Huge Beast, Unaligned*
AC 13 (natural armor), HP 126 (11d12 + 55)

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The mammoth makes two Gore attacks.

Actions.Name: Gore
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. 18 (2d10 + 7) Piercing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature and the mammoth moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target has the Prone condition.

Bonus Actions.Name: Trample
Bonus Actions.Description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 18, one creature within 5 feet that has the Prone condition. Failure: 29 (4d10 + 7) Bludgeoning damage. Success: Half damage.

entities.name: Manticore
entities.description:
*Large Monstrosity, Lawful Evil*
AC 14 (natural armor), HP 68 (8d10 + 24)

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The manticore makes three attacks, using Rend or Tail Spike in any combination.

Actions.Name: Rend
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage.

Actions.Name: Tail Spike
Actions.Description: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 100/200 ft. 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage.

entities.name: Marilith
entities.description:
*Large Fiend, Chaotic Evil*
AC 16 (natural armor), HP 220 (21d10 + 105)

Traits.Name: Demonic Restoration
Traits.Description: If the marilith dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

Traits.Name: Magic Resistance
Traits.Description: The marilith has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Traits.Name: Reactive
Traits.Description: The marilith can take one Reaction on every turn of combat.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The marilith makes six Pact Blade attacks and uses Constrict.

Actions.Name: Pact Blade
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. 10 (1d10 + 5) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.

Actions.Name: Constrict
Actions.Description: Strength Saving Throw: DC 17, one Medium or smaller creature the marilith can see within 5 feet. Failure: 15 (2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

Bonus Actions.Name: Teleport (Recharge 5-6)
Bonus Actions.Description: The marilith teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

Reactions.Name: Parry
Reactions.Description: _Trigger:_ The marilith is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. _Response:_ The marilith adds 5 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

entities.name: Mastiff
entities.description:
*Medium Beast, Unaligned*
AC 12 (natural armor), HP 5 (1d8 + 1)

Actions.Name: Bite
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. 4 (1d6 + 1) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

entities.name: Medusa
entities.description:
*Medium Monstrosity, Lawful Evil*
AC 15 (natural armor), HP 127 (17d8 + 51)

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The medusa makes two Claw attacks and one Snake Hair attack, or it makes three Poison Ray attacks.

Actions.Name: Claw
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

Actions.Name: Snake Hair
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Poison damage.

Actions.Name: Poison Ray
Actions.Description: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 150 ft. 11 (2d8 + 2) Poison damage.

Bonus Actions.Name: Petrifying Gaze (Recharge 5-6)
Bonus Actions.Description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. If the medusa sees its reflection in the Cone, the medusa must make this save. First Failure The target has the Restrained condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on itself on a success. Second Failure The target has the Petrified condition instead of the Restrained condition.

entities.name: Merfolk Skirmisher
entities.description:
*Medium Elemental, Neutral*
AC 11 (natural armor), HP 11 (2d8 + 2)

Traits.Name: Amphibious
Traits.Description: The merfolk can breathe air and water.

Actions.Name: Ocean Spear
Actions.Description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. 3 (1d6) Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Cold damage. If the target is a creature, its Speed decreases by 10 feet until the end of its next turn. HitomThe spear magically returns to the merfolk's hand immediately after a ranged attack.

Attacks.Name: Ocean Spear
Attacks.Reach: Melee or Ranged, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft.

entities.name: Merrow
entities.description:
*Large Monstrosity, Chaotic Evil*
AC 13 (natural armor), HP 45 (6d10 + 12)

Traits.Name: Amphibious
Traits.Description: The merrow can breathe air and water.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The merrow makes two attacks, using Bite, Claw, or Harpoon in any combination.

Actions.Name: Bite
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of the merrow's next turn.

Actions.Name: Claw
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 9 (2d4 + 4) Slashing damage.

Actions.Name: Harpoon
Actions.Description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the merrow pulls the target up to 15 feet straight toward itself.

Attacks.Name: Harpoon
Attacks.Reach: Melee or Ranged, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft.

entities.name: Mimic
entities.description:
*Medium Monstrosity, Neutral*
AC 12 (natural armor), HP 58 (9d8 + 18)

Traits.Name: Adhesive (Object Form Only)
Traits.Description: The mimic adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the mimic has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have Disadvantage.

Actions.Name: Bite
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +5 (with Advantage if the target is Grappled by the mimic), reach 5 ft. 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage—or 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage if the target is Grappled by the mimic—plus 4 (1d8) Acid damage.

Actions.Name: Pseudopod
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) Acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have Disadvantage.

Bonus Actions.Name: Shape-Shift
Bonus Actions.Description: The mimic shape-shifts to resemble a Medium or Small object while retaining its game statistics, or it returns to its true blob form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

entities.name: Minotaur Skeleton
entities.description:
*Large Undead, Lawful Evil*
AC 12 (natural armor), HP 45 (6d10 + 12)

Actions.Name: Gore
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the skeleton moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) Piercing damage and has the Prone condition.

Actions.Name: Slam
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 15 (2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

entities.name: Minotaur of Baphomet
entities.description:
*Large Monstrosity, Chaotic Evil*
AC 14 (natural armor), HP 85 (10d10 + 30)

Actions.Name: Abyssal Glaive
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. 10 (1d12 + 4) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage.

Actions.Name: Gore (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 18 (4d6 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the minotaur moved 10+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) Piercing damage and has the Prone condition.

entities.name: Mule
entities.description:
*Medium Beast, Unaligned*
AC 10 (natural armor), HP 11 (2d8 + 2)

Traits.Name: Beast of Burden
Traits.Description: The mule counts as one size larger for the purpose of determining its carrying capacity.

Actions.Name: Hooves
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 4 (1d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.

entities.name: Mummy
entities.description:
*Small Undead, Lawful Evil*
AC 11 (natural armor), HP 58 (9d8 + 18)

Basics.Immunities: Necrotic, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The mummy makes two Rotting Fist attacks and uses Dreadful Glare.

Actions.Name: Rotting Fist
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 8 (1d10 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is cursed. While cursed, the target can't regain Hit Points, its Hit Point maximum doesn't return to normal when finishing a Long Rest, and its Hit Point maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) every 24 hours that elapse. A creature dies and turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points by this attack.

Actions.Name: Dreadful Glare
Actions.Description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 11, one creature the mummy can see within 60 feet. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition until the end of the mummy's next turn. Success: The target is immune to this mummy's Dreadful Glare for 24 hours.

entities.name: Mummy Lord
entities.description:
*Small Undead, Lawful Evil*
AC 17 (natural armor), HP 187 (25d8 + 75)

Basics.Immunities: Necrotic, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned

Traits.Name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
Traits.Description: If the mummy fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Traits.Name: Magic Resistance
Traits.Description: The mummy has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Traits.Name: Undead Restoration
Traits.Description: If destroyed, the mummy gains a new body in 24 hours if its heart is intact, reviving with all its Hit Points. The new body appears in an unoccupied space within the mummy's lair. The heart is a Tiny object that has AC 17, HP 10, and Immunity to all damage except Fire.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The mummy makes one Rotting Fist or Channel Negative Energy attack, and it uses Dreadful Glare.

Actions.Name: Rotting Fist
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. 15 (2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is cursed. While cursed, the target can't regain Hit Points, it gains no benefit from finishing a Long Rest, and its Hit Point maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) every 24 hours that elapse. A creature dies and turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points by this attack.

Actions.Name: Channel Negative Energy
Actions.Description: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 60 ft. 25 (6d6 + 4) Necrotic damage.

Actions.Name: Dreadful Glare
Actions.Description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 17, one creature the mummy can see within 60 feet. Failure: 25 (6d6 + 4) Psychic damage, and the target has the Paralyzed condition until the end of the mummy's next turn.

Actions.Name: Spellcasting
Actions.Description:
The mummy casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks):

- At Will: Dispel Magic, Thaumaturgy
- 1/Day Each: Animate Dead, Harm, Insect Plague

Reactions.Name: Whirlwind of Sand
Reactions.Description: _Trigger:_ The mummy is hit by an attack roll. _Response:_ The mummy adds 2 to its AC against the attack, possibly causing the attack to miss, and the mummy teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Each creature of its choice that it can see within 5 feet of its destination space has the Blinded condition until the end of the mummy’s next turn.

Legendary Actions.Name: Glare
Legendary Actions.Description: The mummy uses Dreadful Glare. The mummy can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

Legendary Actions.Name: Necrotic Strike
Legendary Actions.Description: The mummy makes one Rotting Fist or Channel Negative Energy attack.

Legendary Actions.Name: Dread Command
Legendary Actions.Description: The mummy casts Command (level 2 version), using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. The mummy can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

entities.name: Nalfeshnee
entities.description:
*Large Fiend, Chaotic Evil*
AC 18 (natural armor), HP 184 (16d10 + 96)

Traits.Name: Demonic Restoration
Traits.Description: If the nalfeshnee dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

Traits.Name: Magic Resistance
Traits.Description: The nalfeshnee has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The nalfeshnee makes three Rend attacks.

Actions.Name: Rend
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. 16 (2d10 + 5) Slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) Force damage.

Actions.Name: Teleport
Actions.Description: The nalfeshnee teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

Bonus Actions.Name: Horror Nimbus (Recharge 5-6)
Bonus Actions.Description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from the nalfeshnee. Failure: 28 (8d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition for 1 minute, until it takes damage, or until it ends its turn with the nalfeshnee out of line of sight. Success: The target is immune to this nalfeshnee's Horror Nimbus for 24 hours.

Reactions.Name: Pursuit
Reactions.Description: _Trigger:_ Another creature the nalfeshnee can see ends its move within 120 feet of the nalfeshnee. _Response:_ The nalfeshnee uses Teleport, but its destination space must be within 10 feet of the triggering creature.

entities.name: Night Hag
entities.description:
*Medium Fiend, Neutral Evil*
AC 17 (natural armor), HP 112 (15d8 + 45)

Traits.Name: Magic Resistance
Traits.Description: The hag has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Traits.Name: Soul Bag
Traits.Description: The hag has a soul bag. While holding or carrying the bag, the hag can use its Nightmare Haunting action. The bag has AC 15, HP 20, and Resistance to all damage. The bag turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points. If the bag is destroyed, any souls the bag is holding are released. The hag can create a new bag after 7 days.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The hag makes two Claw attacks.

Actions.Name: Claw
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage.

Actions.Name: Spellcasting
Actions.Description:
The hag casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

- At Will: Detect Magic, Etherealness, Magic Missile
- 2/Day Each: Phantasmal Killer, Plane Shift

Actions.Name: Nightmare Haunting (1/Day) (Requires Soul Bag)
Actions.Description:
While on the Ethereal Plane, the hag casts Dream, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. Only the hag can serve as the spell's messenger, and the target must be a creature the hag can see on the Material Plane. The spell fails and is wasted if the target is under the effect of the Protection from Evil and Good spell or within a Magic Circle spell. If the target takes damage from the Dream spell, the target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to that damage. If the spell kills the target, its soul is trapped in the hag's soul bag, and the target can't be raised from the dead until its soul is released.

- At Will:
- 1/Day Each: Dream, Protection from Evil and Good, Magic Circle

Bonus Actions.Name: Shape-Shift
Bonus Actions.Description: The hag shape-shifts into a Small or Medium Humanoid, or it returns to its true form. Other than its size, its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

entities.name: Nightmare
entities.description:
*Large Fiend, Neutral Evil*
AC 13 (natural armor), HP 68 (8d10 + 24)

Basics.Languages: Understands Abyssal, Common, And Infernal but can't speak

Traits.Name: Confer Fire Resistance
Traits.Description: The nightmare can grant Resistance to Fire damage to a rider while it is on the nightmare.

Traits.Name: Illumination
Traits.Description: The nightmare sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet.

Actions.Name: Hooves
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage.

Actions.Name: Ethereal Stride
Actions.Description: The nightmare and up to three willing creatures within 5 feet of it teleport to the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane or vice versa.

entities.name: Noble
entities.description:
*Small Humanoid, Neutral*
AC 15 (natural armor), HP 9 (2d8)

Actions.Name: Rapier
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. 5 (1d8 + 1) Piercing damage.

Reactions.Name: Parry
Reactions.Description: _Trigger_: The noble is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. _Response:_ The noble adds 2 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

entities.name: Ochre Jelly
entities.description:
*Large Ooze, Unaligned*
AC 8 (natural armor), HP 52 (7d10 + 14)

Basics.Immunities: Lightning; Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Prone, Restrained

Traits.Name: Amorphous
Traits.Description: The jelly can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

Traits.Name: Spider Climb
Traits.Description: The jelly can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

Actions.Name: Pseudopod
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 12 (3d6 + 2) Acid damage.

Reactions.Name: Split
Reactions.Description: _Trigger:_ While the jelly is Large or Medium and has 10+ Hit Points, it becomes Bloodied or is subjected to Lightning or Slashing damage. _Response:_ The jelly splits into two new Ochre Jellies. Each new jelly is one size smaller than the original jelly and acts on its Initiative. The original jelly’s Hit Points are divided evenly between the new jellies (round down).

entities.name: Octopus
entities.description:
*Small Beast, Unaligned*
AC 12, HP 3 (1d6)

Traits.Name: Compression
Traits.Description: The octopus can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

Traits.Name: Water Breathing
Traits.Description: The octopus can breathe only underwater.

Actions.Name: Tentacles
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Bludgeoning damage.

Reactions.Name: Ink Cloud (1/Day)
Reactions.Description: _Trigger:_ A creature ends its turn within 5 feet of the octopus while underwater. Response: The octopus releases ink that fills a 5-foot Cube centered on itself, and the octopus moves up to its Swim Speed. The Cube is Heavily Obscured for 1 minute or until a strong current or similar effect disperses the ink.

entities.name: Ogre
entities.description:
*Large Giant, Chaotic Evil*
AC 11 (natural armor), HP 68 (8d10 + 24)

Actions.Name: Greatclub
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

Actions.Name: Javelin
Actions.Description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage.

Attacks.Name: Javelin
Attacks.Reach: Melee or Ranged, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft.

entities.name: Ogre Zombie
entities.description:
*Large Undead, Neutral Evil*
AC 8 (natural armor), HP 85 (9d10 + 36)

Basics.Languages: Understands Common and Giant but can't speak

Traits.Name: Undead Fortitude
Traits.Description: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 Hit Points, it makes a Constitution saving throw (DC 5 plus the damage taken) unless the damage is Radiant or from a Critical Hit. On a successful save, the zombie drops to 1 Hit Point instead.

Actions.Name: Slam
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

entities.name: Oni
entities.description:
*Large Fiend, Lawful Evil*
AC 17 (natural armor), HP 119 (14d10 + 42)

Traits.Name: Regeneration
Traits.Description: The oni regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Point.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The oni makes two Claw or Nightmare Ray attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

Actions.Name: Claw
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. 10 (1d12 + 4) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage.

Actions.Name: Nightmare Ray
Actions.Description: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 60 ft. 9 (2d6 + 2) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of the oni's next turn.

Actions.Name: Shape-Shift
Actions.Description: The oni shape-shifts into a Small or Medium Humanoid or a Large Giant, or it returns to its true form. Other than its size, its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

Actions.Name: Spellcasting
Actions.Description:
The oni casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

- At Will:
- 1/Day Each: Charm Person, Darkness, Gaseous Form, Sleep

Bonus Actions.Name: Invisibility
Bonus Actions.Description: The oni casts Invisibility on itself, requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

entities.name: Otyugh
entities.description:
*Large Aberration, Neutral*
AC 14 (natural armor), HP 104 (11d10 + 44)

Basics.Languages: Otyugh; telepathy 120 ft. (doesn't allow the receiving creature to respond telepathically)

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The otyugh makes one Bite attack and two Tentacle attacks.

Actions.Name: Bite
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition. Whenever the Poisoned target finishes a Long Rest, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The target's Hit Point maximum decreases by 5 (1d10) and doesn't return to normal until the Poisoned condition ends on the target. Success: The Poisoned condition ends.

Actions.Name: Tentacle

entities.name: Phase Spider

AC 14 (natural armor), HP 45 (7d10 + 7)

Traits.Name: Ethereal Sight

Traits.Description: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

Actions.Name: Bite

entities.description:

Bonus Actions.Name: Captain's Charm

entities.name: Pit Fiend
entities.description:

Traits.Name: Fear Aura
Traits.Description: The pit fiend emanates an aura in a 20-foot Emanation while it doesn't have the Incapacitated condition. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 21, any enemy that starts its turn in the aura. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn. Success: The target is immune to this pit fiend's aura for 24 hours.

Traits.Name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
Traits.Description: If the pit fiend fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Traits.Name: Magic Resistance
Traits.Description: The pit fiend has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Actions.Name: Multiattack

Actions.Name: Bite
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. 18 (3d6 + 8) Piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must make the following saving throw. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 21. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition. While Poisoned, the target can't regain Hit Points and takes 21 (6d6) Poison damage at the start of each of its turns, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

Actions.Name: Devilish Claw
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. 26 (4d8 + 8) Necrotic damage.

Actions.Name: Fiery Mace
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. 22 (4d6 + 8) Force damage plus 21 (6d6) Fire damage.

Actions.Name: Hellfire Spellcasting (Recharge 4-6)
Actions.Description:
The pit fiend casts Fireball (level 5 version) twice, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 21). It can replace one Fireball with Hold Monster (level 7 version) or Wall of Fire.

- At Will:

entities.name: Plesiosaurus

entities.name: Purple Worm
entities.description:
*Gargantuan Monstrosity, Unaligned*
AC 18 (natural armor), HP 247 (15d20 + 90)

Traits.Name: Tunneler
Traits.Description: The worm can burrow through solid rock at half its Burrow Speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The worm makes one Bite attack and one Tail Stinger attack.

Actions.Name: Bite
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. 22 (3d8 + 9) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 19), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. 16 (2d6 + 9) Piercing damage plus 35 (10d6) Poison damage.

Bonus Actions.Name: Swallow
Bonus Actions.Description: Strength Saving Throw: DC 19, one Large or smaller creature Grappled by the worm (it can have up to three creatures swallowed at a time). Failure: The target is swallowed by the worm, and the Grappled condition ends. A swallowed creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Cover|XPHB|Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the worm, and takes 17 (5d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the worm's turns. If the worm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the worm must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 5 feet of the worm and has the Prone condition. If the worm dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 20 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

entities.name: Quasit
entities.description:

Traits.Name: Magic Resistance

Its game statistics are the same in each form, except for its Speed. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

Actions.Description: The quasit casts Invisibility on itself, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.

Actions.Name: Multiattack

Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage plus 19 (3d12) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is cursed. While cursed, the target gains no benefit from finishing a Short Rest|XPHB|Short or Long Rest.

Actions.Name: Baleful Command (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.Description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 18, each enemy in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the rakshasa. Failure: 28 (8d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened and Incapacitated conditions until the start of the rakshasa's next turn.

Actions.Name: Spellcasting
Actions.Description:
The rakshasa casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18):

- At Will: Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Disguise Self, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion
- 1/Day Each: Fly, Invisibility, Major Image, Plane Shift

If the remorhaz dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

entities.name: Roper

*Large Aberration, Neutral Evil*
AC 20 (natural armor), HP 93 (11d10 + 33)

Traits.Description: The roper can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

entities.name: Saber-Toothed Tiger

entities.name: Salamander

AC 15 (natural armor), HP 90 (12d10 + 24)

Traits.Name: Fire Aura

Attacks.Name: Flame Spear

*Medium Fey, Chaotic Neutral*
AC 13 (natural armor), HP 31 (7d8)

Traits.Name: Magic Resistance
Traits.Description: The satyr has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Actions.Name: Hooves
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 5 (1d4 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the satyr pushes the target up to 10 feet straight away from itself.

Actions.Name: Mockery
Actions.Description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12, one creature the satyr can see within 90 feet. Failure: 5 (1d6 + 2) Psychic damage.

entities.name: Scorpion
entities.description:
*Small Beast, Unaligned*
AC 11 (natural armor), HP 1 (1d4 - 1)

Actions.Name: Sting
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. 1 Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Poison damage.

entities.name: Scout
entities.description:
*Small Humanoid, Neutral*
AC 13 (natural armor), HP 16 (3d8 + 3)

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The scout makes two attacks, using Shortsword and Longbow in any combination.

Actions.Name: Shortsword
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage.

Actions.Name: Longbow
Actions.Description: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 150/600 ft. 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage.

entities.name: Sea Hag
entities.description:
*Medium Fey, Chaotic Evil*
AC 14 (natural armor), HP 52 (7d8 + 21)

Traits.Name: Amphibious
Traits.Description: The hag can breathe air and water.

Traits.Name: Vile Appearance
Traits.Description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 11, any Beast or Humanoid that starts its turn within 30 feet of the hag and can see the hag's true form. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn. Success: The target is immune to this hag's Vile Appearance for 24 hours.

Actions.Name: Claw
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

Actions.Name: Death Glare (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.Description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 11, one Frightened creature the hag can see within 30 feet. Failure: If the target has 20 Hit Points or fewer, it drops to 0 Hit Points. Otherwise, the target takes 13 (3d8) Psychic damage.

Actions.Name: Illusory Appearance
Actions.Description: The hag casts Disguise Self, using Constitution as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13). The spell's duration is 24 hours.

entities.name: Seahorse
entities.description:
*Small Beast, Unaligned*
AC 12 (natural armor), HP 1 (1d4 - 1)

Traits.Name: Water Breathing
Traits.Description: The seahorse can breathe only underwater.

Actions.Name: Bubble Dash
Actions.Description: While underwater, the seahorse moves up to its Swim Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

entities.name: Shadow
entities.description:
*Medium Undead, Chaotic Evil*
AC 12 (natural armor), HP 27 (5d8 + 5)

Basics.Immunities: Necrotic, Poison; Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious

Traits.Name: Amorphous
Traits.Description: The shadow can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

Traits.Name: Sunlight Weakness
Traits.Description: While in sunlight, the shadow has Disadvantage on D20 Test.

Actions.Name: Draining Swipe
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 5 (1d6 + 2) Necrotic damage, and the target's Strength score decreases by 1d4. The target dies if this reduces that score to 0. If a Humanoid is slain by this attack, a Shadow rises from the corpse 1d4 hours later.

Bonus Actions.Name: Shadow Stealth
Bonus Actions.Description: While in Dim Light or darkness, the shadow takes the Hide action.

entities.name: Shambling Mound
entities.description:
*Large Plant, Unaligned*
AC 15 (natural armor), HP 110 (13d10 + 39)

Traits.Name: Lightning Absorption
Traits.Description: Whenever the shambling mound is subjected to Lightning damage, it regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Lightning damage dealt.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The shambling mound makes three Charged Tendril attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Engulf.

Actions.Name: Charged Tendril
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. 7 (1d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) Lightning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the shambling mound pulls the target 5 feet straight toward itself.

Actions.Name: Engulf
Actions.Description: Strength Saving Throw: DC 15, one Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet. Failure: The target is pulled into the shambling mound's space and has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14). Until the grapple ends, the target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, and it takes 10 (3d6) Lightning damage at the start of each of its turns. When the shambling mound moves, the Grappled target moves with it, costing it no extra movement. The shambling mound can have only one creature Grappled by this action at a time.

entities.name: Shield Guardian
entities.description:
*Large Construct, Unaligned*
AC 17 (natural armor), HP 142 (15d10 + 60)

Basics.Immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
Basics.Languages: Understands commands given in any language but can't speak

Traits.Name: Bound
Traits.Description: The guardian is magically bound to an amulet. While the guardian and its amulet are on the same plane of existence, the amulet's wearer can telepathically call the guardian to travel to it, and the guardian knows the distance and direction to the amulet. If the guardian is within 60 feet of the amulet's wearer, half of any damage the wearer takes (round up) is transferred to the guardian.

Traits.Name: Regeneration
Traits.Description: The guardian regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Point.

Traits.Name: Spell Storing
Traits.Description: A spellcaster who wears the guardian's amulet can cause the guardian to store one spell of level 4 or lower. To do so, the wearer must cast the spell on the guardian while within 5 feet of it. The spell has no effect but is stored within the guardian. Any previously stored spell is lost when a new spell is stored. The guardian can cast the spell stored with any parameters set by the original caster, requiring no spell components and using the caster's spellcasting ability. The stored spell is then lost.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The guardian makes two Fist attacks.

Actions.Name: Fist
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Force damage.

Reactions.Name: Protection
Reactions.Description: _Trigger:_ An attack roll hits the wearer of the guardian’s amulet while the wearer is within 5 feet of the guardian. _Response:_ The wearer gains a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack and possibly causing it to miss, until the start of the guardian’s next turn.

entities.name: Shrieker Fungus
entities.description:
*Medium Plant, Unaligned*
AC 5 (natural armor), HP 13 (3d8)

Reactions.Name: Shriek
Reactions.Description: _Trigger:_ A creature or a source of Bright Light moves within 30 feet of the shrieker. _Response:_ The shrieker emits a shriek audible within 300 feet of itself for 1 minute or until the shrieker dies.

entities.name: Silver Dragon Wyrmling
entities.description:
*Medium Dragon, Lawful Good*
AC 17 (natural armor), HP 45 (6d8 + 18)

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The dragon makes two Rend attacks.

Actions.Name: Rend
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 9 (1d10 + 4) Piercing damage.

Actions.Name: Cold Breath (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.Description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 18 (4d8) Cold damage. Success: Half damage.

Actions.Name: Paralyzing Breath
Actions.Description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. First Failure The target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn, when it repeats the save. Second Failure The target has the Paralyzed condition, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

entities.name: Skeleton
entities.description:
*Medium Undead, Lawful Evil*
AC 14 (natural armor), HP 13 (2d8 + 4)

Basics.Languages: Understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

Actions.Name: Shortsword
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

Actions.Name: Shortbow
Actions.Description: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 80/320 ft. 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

entities.name: Solar
entities.description:
*Large Celestial, Lawful Good*
AC 21 (natural armor), HP 297 (22d10 + 176)

Basics.Immunities: Poison, Radiant; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Poisoned

Traits.Name: Divine Awareness
Traits.Description: The solar knows if it hears a lie.

Traits.Name: Exalted Restoration
Traits.Description: If the solar dies outside Mount Celestia, its body disappears, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in Mount Celestia.

Traits.Name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
Traits.Description: If the solar fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Traits.Name: Magic Resistance
Traits.Description: The solar has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The solar makes two Flying Sword attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Slaying Bow.

Actions.Name: Flying Sword
Actions.Description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +15, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft. 22 (4d6 + 8) Slashing damage plus 36 (8d8) Radiant damage. HitomThe sword magically returns to the solar's hand or hovers within 5 feet of the solar immediately after a ranged attack.

Actions.Name: Slaying Bow
Actions.Description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 21, one creature the solar can see within 600 feet. Failure: If the creature has 100 Hit Points or fewer, it dies. It otherwise takes 24 (4d8 + 6) Piercing damage plus 36 (8d8) Radiant damage.

Actions.Name: Spellcasting
Actions.Description:
The solar casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 25):

- At Will: Detect Evil and Good
- 1/Day Each: Commune, Control Weather, Dispel Evil and Good, Resurrection

Bonus Actions.Name: Divine Aid (3/Day)
Bonus Actions.Description: The solar casts Cure Wounds (level 2 version), Lesser Restoration, or Remove Curse, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

Legendary Actions.Name: Blinding Gaze
Legendary Actions.Description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 25, one creature the solar can see within 120 feet. Failure: The target has the Blinded condition for 1 minute. Failure or Success: The solar can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

Legendary Actions.Name: Radiant Teleport
Legendary Actions.Description: The solar teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 25, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the solar at its destination space. Failure: 11 (2d10) Radiant damage. Success: Half damage.

Attacks.Name: Flying Sword
Attacks.Reach: Melee or Ranged, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft.

entities.name: Specter
entities.description:
*Medium Undead, Chaotic Evil*
AC 12 (natural armor), HP 22 (5d8)

Basics.Immunities: Necrotic, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious
Basics.Languages: Understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

Traits.Name: Incorporeal Movement
Traits.Description: The specter can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

Traits.Name: Sunlight Sensitivity
Traits.Description: While in sunlight, the specter has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

Actions.Name: Life Drain
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, its Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken.

entities.name: Sphinx of Lore
entities.description:
*Large Celestial, Lawful Neutral*
AC 17 (natural armor), HP 170 (20d10 + 60)

Traits.Name: Inscrutable
Traits.Description: No magic can observe the sphinx remotely or detect its thoughts without its permission. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain its intentions or sincerity are made with Disadvantage.

Traits.Name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
Traits.Description: If the sphinx fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The sphinx makes three Claw attacks.

Actions.Name: Claw
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. 14 (3d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

Actions.Name: Mind-Rending Roar (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.Description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16, each enemy in a 300-foot Emanation originating from the sphinx. Failure: 35 (10d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Incapacitated condition until the start of the sphinx's next turn.

Actions.Name: Spellcasting
Actions.Description:
The sphinx casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):

- At Will: Detect Magic, Identify, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation
- 1/Day Each: Dispel Magic, Legend Lore, Locate Object, Plane Shift, Remove Curse, Tongues

Legendary Actions.Name: Arcane Prowl
Legendary Actions.Description: The sphinx can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, and it makes one Claw attack.

Legendary Actions.Name: Weight of Years
Legendary Actions.Description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the sphinx can see within 120 feet. Failure: The target gains 1 Exhaustion level. While the target has any Exhaustion levels, it appears 3d10 years older. Failure or Success: The sphinx can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

entities.name: Sphinx of Valor
entities.description:
*Large Celestial, Lawful Neutral*
AC 17 (natural armor), HP 199 (19d10 + 95)

Traits.Name: Inscrutable
Traits.Description: No magic can observe the sphinx remotely or detect its thoughts without its permission. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain its intentions or sincerity are made with Disadvantage.

Traits.Name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
Traits.Description: If the sphinx fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The sphinx makes two Claw attacks and uses Roar.

Actions.Name: Claw
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 5 ft. 20 (4d6 + 6) Slashing damage.

Actions.Name: Roar (3/Day)
Actions.Description: The sphinx emits a magical roar. Whenever it roars, the roar has a different effect, as detailed below (the sequence resets when it takes a Long Rest): - First Roar: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 20, each enemy in a 500-foot Emanation originating from the sphinx. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition for 1 minute. - Second Roar: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 20, each enemy in a 500-foot Emanation originating from the sphinx. Failure: The target has the Paralyzed condition, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. - Third Roar: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20, each enemy in a 500-foot Emanation originating from the sphinx. Failure: 44 (8d10) Thunder damage, and the target has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only.

Actions.Name: Spellcasting
Actions.Description:
The sphinx casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20):

- At Will: Detect Evil and Good, Thaumaturgy
- 1/Day Each: Detect Magic, Dispel Magic, Greater Restoration, Heroes' Feast, Zone of Truth

Legendary Actions.Name: Arcane Prowl
Legendary Actions.Description: The sphinx can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, and it makes one Claw attack.

Legendary Actions.Name: Weight of Years
Legendary Actions.Description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the sphinx can see within 120 feet. Failure: The target gains 1 Exhaustion level. While the target has any Exhaustion levels, it appears 3d10 years older. Failure or Success: The sphinx can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

entities.name: Sphinx of Wonder
entities.description:
*Small Celestial, Lawful Good*
AC 13 (natural armor), HP 24 (7d4 + 7)

Traits.Name: Magic Resistance
Traits.Description: The sphinx has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Actions.Name: Rend
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 5 (1d4 + 3) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Radiant damage.

Reactions.Name: Burst of Ingenuity (2/Day)
Reactions.Description: _Trigger:_ The sphinx or another creature within 30 feet makes an ability check or a saving throw. _Response:_ The sphinx adds 2 to the roll.

entities.name: Spider
entities.description:
*Small Beast, Unaligned*
AC 12 (natural armor), HP 1 (1d4 - 1)

Traits.Name: Spider Climb
Traits.Description: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

Traits.Name: Web Walker
Traits.Description: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the spider knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

Actions.Name: Bite
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 1 Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage.

entities.name: Spirit Naga
entities.description:
*Large Fiend, Chaotic Evil*
AC 17 (natural armor), HP 135 (18d10 + 36)

Traits.Name: Fiendish Restoration
Traits.Description: If it dies, the naga returns to life in 1d6 days and regains all its Hit Points. Only a Wish spell can prevent this trait from functioning.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The naga makes three attacks, using Bite or Necrotic Ray in any combination.

Actions.Name: Bite
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Poison damage.

Actions.Name: Necrotic Ray
Actions.Description: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 60 ft. 21 (6d6) Necrotic damage.

Actions.Name: Spellcasting
Actions.Description:
The naga casts one of the following spells, requiring no Somatic or Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

- At Will: Detect Magic, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Water Breathing
- 2/Day Each: Detect Thoughts, Dimension Door, Hold Person, Lightning Bolt

entities.name: Sprite
entities.description:
*Small Fey, Neutral Good*
AC 15 (natural armor), HP 10 (4d4)

Actions.Name: Needle Sword
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing damage.

Actions.Name: Enchanting Bow
Actions.Description: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 40/160 ft. 1 Piercing damage, and the target has the Charmed condition until the start of the sprite's next turn.

Actions.Name: Heart Sight
Actions.Description: Charisma Saving Throw: DC 10, one creature within 5 feet the sprite can see (Celestials, Fiends, and Undead automatically fail the save). Failure: The sprite knows the target's emotions and alignment.

Actions.Name: Invisibility
Actions.Description: The sprite casts Invisibility on itself, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.

entities.name: Spy
entities.description:
*Small Humanoid, Neutral*
AC 12 (natural armor), HP 27 (6d8)

Actions.Name: Shortsword
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

Actions.Name: Hand Crossbow
Actions.Description: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 30/120 ft. 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

Bonus Actions.Name: Cunning Action
Bonus Actions.Description: The spy takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

entities.name: Steam Mephit
entities.description:
*Small Elemental, Neutral Evil*
AC 10 (natural armor), HP 17 (5d6)

Traits.Name: Blurred Form
Traits.Description: Attack rolls against the mephit are made with Disadvantage unless the mephit has the Incapacitated condition.

Traits.Name: Death Burst
Traits.Description: The mephit explodes when it dies. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the mephit. Failure: 5 (2d4) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

Actions.Name: Claw
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. 2 (1d4) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Fire damage.

Actions.Name: Steam Breath (Recharge 6)
Actions.Description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 5 (2d4) Fire damage, and the target's Speed decreases by 10 feet until the end of the mephit's next turn. Success: Half damage only. Failure or Success: Being underwater doesn't grant Resistance to this Fire damage.

entities.name: Stirge
entities.description:
*Small Monstrosity, Unaligned*
AC 13 (natural armor), HP 5 (2d4)

Actions.Name: Proboscis
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage, and the stirge attaches to the target. While attached, the stirge can't make Proboscis attacks, and the target takes 5 (2d4) Necrotic damage at the start of each of the stirge's turns. The stirge can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. The target or a creature within 5 feet of it can detach the stirge as an action.

entities.name: Stone Giant
entities.description:
*Huge Giant, Neutral*
AC 17 (natural armor), HP 126 (11d12 + 55)

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The giant makes two attacks, using Stone Club or Boulder in any combination.

Actions.Name: Stone Club
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 15 ft. 22 (3d10 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.

Actions.Name: Boulder
Actions.Description: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 60/240 ft. 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

Reactions.Name: Deflect Missile (Recharge 5-6)
Reactions.Description: _Trigger:_ The giant is hit by a ranged attack roll and takes Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage from it. _Response:_ The giant reduces the damage it takes from the attack by 11 (1d10 + 6), and if that damage is reduced to 0, the giant can redirect some of the attack’s force. _Dexterity Saving Throw:_ DC 17, one creature the giant can see within 60 feet. Failure: 11 (1d10 + 6) Force damage.

entities.name: Stone Golem
entities.description:
*Large Construct, Unaligned*
AC 18 (natural armor), HP 220 (21d10 + 105)

Basics.Immunities: Poison, Psychic; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
Basics.Languages: Understands Common plus two other languages but can't speak

Traits.Name: Immutable Form
Traits.Description: The golem can't shape-shift.

Traits.Name: Magic Resistance
Traits.Description: The golem has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The golem makes two attacks, using Slam or Force Bolt in any combination.

Actions.Name: Slam
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) Force damage.

Actions.Name: Force Bolt
Actions.Description: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 120 ft. 22 (4d10) Force damage.

Bonus Actions.Name: Slow (Recharge 5-6)
Bonus Actions.Description: The golem casts the Slow spell, requiring no spell components and using Constitution as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17).

entities.name: Storm Giant
entities.description:
*Huge Giant, Chaotic Good*
AC 16 (natural armor), HP 230 (20d12 + 100)

Traits.Name: Amphibious
Traits.Description: The giant can breathe air and water.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The giant makes two attacks, using Storm Sword or Thunderbolt in any combination.

Actions.Name: Storm Sword
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. 23 (4d6 + 9) Slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) Lightning damage.

Actions.Name: Thunderbolt
Actions.Description: Ranged Attack Roll: +14, range 500 ft. 22 (2d12 + 9) Lightning damage, and the target has the Blinded and Deafened conditions until the start of the giant's next turn.

Actions.Name: Lightning Storm (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.Description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 18, each creature in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder originating from a point the giant can see within 500 feet. Failure: 55 (10d10) Lightning damage. Success: Half damage.

Actions.Name: Spellcasting
Actions.Description:
The giant casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18):

- At Will: Detect Magic, Light
- 1/Day Each: Control Weather

entities.name: Succubus
entities.description:
*Medium Fiend, Neutral Evil*
AC 15 (natural armor), HP 71 (13d8 + 13)

Traits.Name: Incubus Form
Traits.Description: When the succubus finishes a Long Rest, it can shape-shift into an Incubus, using that stat block instead of this one.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The succubus makes one Fiendish Touch attack and uses Charm or Draining Kiss.

Actions.Name: Fiendish Touch
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. 16 (2d10 + 5) Psychic damage.

Actions.Name: Charm
Actions.Description: The succubus casts Dominate Person (level 8 version), requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15).

Actions.Name: Draining Kiss
Actions.Description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, one creature Charmed by the succubus within 5 feet. Failure: 13 (3d8) Psychic damage. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: The target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken.

Bonus Actions.Name: Shape-Shift
Bonus Actions.Description: The succubus shape-shifts to resemble a Medium or Small Humanoid or back into its true form. Its game statistics are the same in each form, except its Fly Speed is available only in its true form. Any equipment it's wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

entities.name: Swarm of Bats
entities.description:
*Large Beast, Unaligned*
AC 12 (natural armor), HP 11 (2d10)

Traits.Name: Swarm
Traits.Description: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny bat. The swarm can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

Actions.Name: Bites
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 5 (2d4) Piercing damage, or 2 (1d4) Piercing damage if the swarm is Bloodied.

entities.name: Swarm of Crawling Claws
entities.description:
*Medium Undead, Neutral Evil*
AC 12 (natural armor), HP 49 (11d8)

Basics.Immunities: Necrotic, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Incapacitated, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Stunned

Traits.Name: Swarm
Traits.Description: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny creature. The swarm can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

Actions.Name: Swarm of Grasping Hands
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 20 (4d8 + 2) Necrotic damage, or 11 (2d8 + 2) Necrotic damage if the swarm is Bloodied. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

entities.name: Swarm of Insects
entities.description:
*Medium Beast, Unaligned*
AC 11 (natural armor), HP 19 (3d8 + 6)

Traits.Name: Spider Climb
Traits.Description: If the swarm has a Climb Speed, the swarm can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

Traits.Name: Swarm
Traits.Description: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect. The swarm can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

Actions.Name: Bites

Traits.Name: Water Breathing
Traits.Description: The swarm can breathe only underwater.

Actions.Name: Bites
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +5 (with Advantage if the target doesn't have all its Hit Points), reach 5 ft. 8 (2d4 + 3) Piercing damage, or 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage if the swarm is Bloodied.

entities.name: Swarm of Rats
entities.description:
*Medium Beast, Unaligned*
AC 10 (natural armor), HP 14 (4d8 - 4)

Traits.Name: Swarm
Traits.Description: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny rat. The swarm can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

Actions.Name: Bites
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. 5 (2d4) Piercing damage, or 2 (1d4) Piercing damage if the swarm is Bloodied.

entities.name: Swarm of Ravens
entities.description:
*Medium Beast, Unaligned*
AC 12 (natural armor), HP 11 (2d8 + 2)

Traits.Name: Swarm
Traits.Description: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny raven. The swarm can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

Actions.Name: Beaks
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage, or 2 (1d4) Piercing damage if the swarm is Bloodied.

Actions.Name: Cacophony (Recharge 6)
Actions.Description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 10, one creature in the swarm's space. Failure: The target has the Deafened condition until the start of the swarm's next turn. While Deafened, the target also has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

entities.name: Swarm of Venomous Snakes
entities.description:
*Medium Beast, Unaligned*
AC 14 (natural armor), HP 36 (8d8)

Traits.Name: Swarm

entities.name: Tarrasque
entities.description:
*Gargantuan Monstrosity, Unaligned*
AC 25 (natural armor), HP 697 (34d20 + 340)

Basics.Immunities: Fire, Poison; Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned

Traits.Name: Legendary Resistance (6/Day)
Traits.Description: If the tarrasque fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Traits.Name: Magic Resistance
Traits.Description: The tarrasque has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Traits.Name: Reflective Carapace
Traits.Description: If the tarrasque is targeted by a Magic Missile spell or a spell that requires a ranged attack roll, roll 1d6. On a 1-5, the tarrasque is unaffected. On a 6, the tarrasque is unaffected and reflects the spell, turning the caster into the target.

Traits.Name: Siege Monster
Traits.Description: The tarrasque deals double damage to objects and structures.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The tarrasque makes one Bite attack and three other attacks, using Claw or Tail in any combination.

Actions.Name: Bite
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +19, reach 15 ft. 36 (4d12 + 10) Piercing damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 20). Until the grapple ends, the target has the Restrained condition and can't teleport.

Actions.Name: Claw
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +19, reach 15 ft. 28 (4d8 + 10) Slashing damage.

Actions.Name: Tail
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +19, reach 30 ft. 23 (3d8 + 10) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

Actions.Name: Thunderous Bellow (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.Description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 27, each creature and each object that isn't being worn or carried in a 150-foot Cone. Failure: 78 (12d12) Thunder damage, and the target has the Deafened and Frightened conditions until the end of its next turn. Success: Half damage only.

Bonus Actions.Name: Swallow
Bonus Actions.Description: Strength Saving Throw: DC 27, one Large or smaller creature Grappled by the tarrasque (it can have up to six creatures swallowed at a time). Failure: The target is swallowed, and the Grappled condition ends. A swallowed creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions and can't teleport, it has Cover|XPHB|Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the tarrasque, and it takes 56 (16d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the tarrasque's turns. If the tarrasque takes 60 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the tarrasque must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 10 feet of the tarrasque and has the Prone condition. If the tarrasque dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 20 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

Legendary Actions.Name: Onslaught
Legendary Actions.Description: The tarrasque moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Claw or Tail attack.

Legendary Actions.Name: World-Shaking Movement
Legendary Actions.Description: The tarrasque moves up to its Speed. At the end of this movement, the tarrasque creates an instantaneous shock wave in a 60-foot Emanation originating from itself. Creatures in that area lose Concentration and, if Medium or smaller, have the Prone condition. The tarrasque can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

entities.name: Tiger
entities.description:
*Large Beast, Unaligned*
AC 13 (natural armor), HP 30 (4d10 + 8)

Actions.Name: Rend
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

Bonus Actions.Name: Nimble Escape
Bonus Actions.Description: The tiger takes the Disengage or Hide action.

entities.name: Tough
entities.description:

Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 5 (1d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.

Traits.Description: The tough has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the tough's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

Traits.Description: The treant deals double damage to objects and structures.

Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. 16 (3d6 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.

Actions.Description: Ranged Attack Roll: +10, range 180 ft. 28 (4d10 + 6) Piercing damage.

Actions.Name: Animate Trees (1/Day)
Actions.Description: The treant magically animates up to two trees it can see within 60 feet of itself. Each tree uses the Treant stat block, except it has Intelligence and Charisma scores of 1, it can't speak, and it lacks this action. The tree takes its turn immediately after the treant on the same Initiative count, and it obeys the treant. A tree remains animate for 1 day or until it dies, the treant dies, or it is more than 120 feet from the treant. The tree then takes root if possible.

entities.name: Triceratops
entities.description:
*Huge Beast, Unaligned*
AC 14 (natural armor), HP 114 (12d12 + 36)

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The triceratops makes two Gore attacks.

Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. 19 (2d12 + 6) Piercing damage. If the target is Huge or smaller and the triceratops moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) Piercing damage and has the Prone condition.

entities.name: Troll
entities.description:
*Large Giant, Chaotic Evil*
AC 15 (natural armor), HP 94 (9d10 + 45)

Traits.Name: Loathsome Limbs (4/Day)
Traits.Description: If the troll ends any turn Bloodied and took 15+ Slashing damage during that turn, one of the troll's limbs is severed, falls into the troll's space, and becomes a Troll Limb. The limb acts immediately after the troll's turn. The troll has 1 Exhaustion level for each missing limb, and it grows replacement limbs the next time it regains Hit Points.

Traits.Name: Regeneration
Traits.Description: The troll regains 15 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If the troll takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function on the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The troll makes three Rend attacks.

Actions.Name: Rend
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

Bonus Actions.Name: Charge
Bonus Actions.Description: The troll moves up to half its Speed straight toward an enemy it can see.

entities.name: Troll Limb
entities.description:
*Small Giant, Chaotic Evil*
AC 13 (natural armor), HP 14 (4d6)

Traits.Name: Regeneration
Traits.Description: The limb regains 5 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If the limb takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function on the limb's next turn. The limb dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

Traits.Name: Troll Spawn
Traits.Description: The limb uncannily has the same senses as a whole troll. If the limb isn't destroyed within 24 hours, roll 1d12. On a 12, the limb turns into a Troll. Otherwise, the limb withers away.

Actions.Name: Rend
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 9 (2d4 + 4) Slashing damage.

entities.name: Tyrannosaurus Rex
entities.description:
*Huge Beast, Unaligned*
AC 13 (natural armor), HP 136 (13d12 + 52)

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The tyrannosaurus makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack.

Actions.Name: Bite
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. 33 (4d12 + 7) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 17). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition and can't be targeted by the tyrannosaurus's Tail.

Actions.Name: Tail
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 15 ft. 25 (4d8 + 7) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

entities.name: Unicorn
entities.description:
*Large Celestial, Lawful Good*
AC 12 (natural armor), HP 97 (13d10 + 26)

Traits.Name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
Traits.Description: If the unicorn fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Traits.Name: Magic Resistance
Traits.Description: The unicorn has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The unicorn makes one Hooves attack and one Radiant Horn attack.

Actions.Name: Hooves
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

Actions.Name: Radiant Horn
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. 9 (1d10 + 4) Radiant damage.

Actions.Name: Spellcasting
Actions.Description:
The unicorn casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

- At Will: Detect Evil and Good, Druidcraft
- 1/Day Each: Calm Emotions, Dispel Evil and Good, Entangle, Pass without Trace, Word of Recall

Bonus Actions.Name: Unicorn's Blessing (3/Day)
Bonus Actions.Description: The unicorn touches another creature with its horn and casts Cure Wounds or Lesser Restoration on that creature, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

Legendary Actions.Name: Charging Horn
Legendary Actions.Description: The unicorn moves up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks, and it makes one Radiant Horn attack.

Legendary Actions.Name: Shimmering Shield
Legendary Actions.Description: The unicorn targets itself or one creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. The target gains 10 (3d6) Temporary Hit Points, and its AC increases by 2 until the end of the unicorn's next turn. The unicorn can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

entities.name: Vampire
entities.description:
*Small Undead, Lawful Evil*
AC 16 (natural armor), HP 195 (23d8 + 92)

Traits.Name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
Traits.Description: If the vampire fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Traits.Name: Misty Escape
Traits.Description: If the vampire drops to 0 Hit Points outside its resting place, the vampire uses Shape-Shift to become mist (no action required). If it can't use Shape-Shift, it is destroyed. While it has 0 Hit Points in mist form, it can't return to its vampire form, and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it returns to its vampire form and has the Paralyzed condition until it regains any Hit Points, and it regains 1 Hit Point after spending 1 hour there.

Traits.Name: Spider Climb
Traits.Description: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

Traits.Name: Vampire Weakness
Traits.Description:
The vampire has these weaknesses:

- Forbiddance: The vampire can't enter a residence without an invitation from an occupant.
- Running Water: The vampire takes 20 Acid damage if it ends its turn in running water.
- Stake to the Heart: If a weapon that deals Piercing damage is driven into the vampire's heart while the vampire has the Incapacitated condition in its resting place, the vampire has the Paralyzed condition until the weapon is removed.
- Sunlight: The vampire takes 20 Radiant damage if it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

Actions.Name: Multiattack (Vampire Form Only)
Actions.Description: The vampire makes two Grave Strike attacks and uses Bite.

Actions.Name: Grave Strike (Vampire Form Only)
Actions.Description: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. 8 (1d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of two hands.

Actions.Name: Bite (Bat or Vampire Form Only)
Actions.Description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or that has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. Failure: 6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) Necrotic damage. The target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains Hit Points equal to that amount. A Humanoid reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage and then buried rises the following sunset as a Vampire Spawn under the vampire's control.

Bonus Actions.Name: Shape-Shift
Bonus Actions.Description: If the vampire isn't in sunlight or running water, it shape-shifts into a Tiny bat (Speed 5 ft., Fly Speed 30 ft.) or a Medium cloud of mist (Speed 5 ft., Fly Speed 20 ft. [hover]), or it returns to its vampire form. Anything it is wearing transforms with it. While in bat form, the vampire can't speak. Its game statistics, other than its size and Speed, are unchanged. While in mist form, the vampire can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It is weightless and can enter an enemy's space and stop there. If air can pass through a space, the mist can do so, but it can't pass through liquid. It has Resistance to all damage, except the damage it takes from sunlight.

Bonus Actions.Name: Charm (Recharge 5-6)
Bonus Actions.Description: The vampire casts Charm Person, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17), and the duration is 24 hours. The Charmed target is a willing recipient of the vampire's Bite, the damage of which doesn't end the spell. When the spell ends, the target is unaware it was Charmed by the vampire.

Legendary Actions.Name: Deathless Strike
Legendary Actions.Description: The vampire moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Grave Strike attack.

Legendary Actions.Name: Beguile
Legendary Actions.Description: The vampire casts Command, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17). The vampire can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

entities.name: Vampire Familiar
entities.description:
*Small Humanoid, Neutral Evil*
AC 15 (natural armor), HP 65 (10d8 + 20)

Traits.Name: Vampiric Connection
Traits.Description: While the familiar and its vampire master are on the same plane of existence, the vampire can communicate with the familiar telepathically, and the vampire can perceive through the familiar's senses.

Actions.Name: Multiattack
Actions.Description: The familiar makes two Umbral Dagger attacks.

Actions.Name: Umbral Dagger
Actions.Description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 7 (3d4) Necrotic damage. If the target is reduced to 0 Hit Points by this attack, the target becomes Stable but has the Poisoned condition for 1 hour. While it has the Poisoned condition, the target has the Paralyzed condition.

Bonus Actions.Name: Deathless Agility
Bonus Actions.Description: The familiar takes the Dash or Disengage action.

Attacks.Name: Umbral Dagger
Attacks.Reach: Melee or Ranged, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft.

entities.name: Vampire Spawn
entities.description:

AC 16 (natural armor), HP 90 (12d8 + 36)

- Stake to the Heart: The vampire is destroyed if a weapon that deals Piercing damage is driven into the vampire's heart while the vampire has the Incapacitated condition.
